title: When Do Discrete Actions Make Good Continuous Controllers?
summary: Though modern AI models like LLMs predict discrete tokens, today's robotic foundation models represent actions as continuous vectors. In this paper, we challenge this common consensus by asking if continuous action parametrizations are superior to their discrete counterparts. We conduct an extensive comparison of single-step regression and multi-step flow variants of both continuous and discrete policies in both from-scratch single-task and multi-task VLA training, in both simulation and on real hardware. In all regimes, we find that discrete action prediction, even the most naive, uniform-bin quantization, can match or even outperform continuous-action policies in task success rate. Moreover, we find that the challenge to discrete action policies is \emph{not} action precision, but rather factorization error introduced by product-distribution predictions across time and action dimensions. We show that, when paired with the correct interventions---iterative computation through discrete flows, or distribution sharpening through classifier-free guidance---discrete flow policies can turn this weakness into a strength, enabling more responsive action changes during a predicted action chunk. Lastly, we show that attempts to explicitly inject geometric information into discrete policies, e.g. through corruption processes that emulate continuous flow matching, do \emph{not} yield consistent improvements. Taken together, our findings question existing assumptions that robotic action prediction requires distinct design decisions compared to other AI domains, and motivates the possibility of discrete action prediction as a compelling alternative to today's continuous action parametrizations. Link for the webpage \href{https://iscoyizj.github.io/discrete-action-website/}{https://iscoyizj.github.io/discrete-action-website/}
tldr: This paper systematically compares continuous vs. discrete action parametrizations for robot policies, finding that even naive uniform-bin discrete actions can match or outperform continuous policies in task success rate, and that discrete flow policies with interventions like classifier-free guidance can enable more responsive action changes.
tldr_zh: 本文系统比较了机器人策略中连续动作与离散动作的参数化，发现即使是朴素的均匀分箱离散动作也能在任务成功率上匹配甚至超越连续策略，且通过分类器自由引导等干预，离散流策略能实现更灵敏的动作变化。
summary_zh: 尽管现代AI模型如LLM预测离散标记，但当今的机器人基础模型将动作表示为连续向量。在本文中，我们挑战这一普遍共识，探究连续动作参数化是否优于其离散对应形式。我们在从零开始的单任务和多任务VLA训练中，以及在仿真和真实硬件上，对连续策略和离散策略的单步回归与多步流变体进行了广泛比较。在所有设定下，我们发现离散动作预测——即使是最简单的均匀分箱量化——在任务成功率上也能匹配甚至超越连续动作策略。此外，我们发现离散动作策略面临的挑战并非动作精度，而是跨时间和动作维度的乘积分布预测所带来的分解误差。我们表明，当与正确的干预措施相结合时——通过离散流进行迭代计算，或通过无分类器引导进行分布锐化——离散流策略能将这一弱点转化为优势，使其在预测动作块期间能够实现更灵敏的动作变化。最后，我们表明，试图将几何信息显式注入离散策略（例如通过模拟连续流匹配的腐蚀过程）并不会带来一致的改进。综合来看，我们的研究结果质疑了机器人动作预测需要与其他AI领域相比做出不同设计决策的现有假设，并提出了离散动作预测作为当今连续动作参数化的一种有说服力的替代方案的可能性。网页链接：\href{https://iscoyizj.github.io/discrete-action-website/}{https://iscoyizj.github.io/discrete-action-website/}

title: TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Large-scale robot learning increasingly relies on diverse human demonstrations, yet tactile manipulation data remain difficult to scale, and existing multimodal datasets often lack consistent quality control and structured supervision. We present TacClaw-Infinity, a large-scale structured Vision-Tactile-Language-Action (VTLA) dataset for contact-rich manipulation, collected with TacClaw, a tactile-enabled UMI-style handheld interface that records synchronized visual observations, fingertip tactile signals, and end-effector trajectories without requiring a target robot during data collection. TacClaw-Infinity is built through a distributed worldwide collection across homes, laboratories, industrial workplaces, retail stores, and outdoor environments including tasks contributed by academic and industrial collaborators. Together, these efforts yield over 10,000 hours, 1 million episodes, and 1 billion frames spanning more than 1,000 task types. We develop a scalable pipeline for trajectory reconstruction, multimodal quality control, embodiment-aware filtering, and structured annotation, covering contact-centric segmentation, subtask description, and spatial grounding. We validate TacClaw-Infinity at both the data and model levels: At the data level, we assess the collection interface, the action-space compatibility of the curated demonstrations, and the structured annotations, while for the model level, we demonstrate cross-embodiment transfer across three heterogeneous robots without robot-specific demonstrations.
tldr: This paper introduces TacClaw-Infinity, a large-scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action dataset for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, collected via a handheld tactile-enabled interface across diverse real-world environments, and validates its utility through cross-embodiment transfer experiments on heterogeneous robots.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了TacClaw-Infinity，一个大规模视觉-触觉-语言-动作数据集，用于接触丰富的灵巧操作，通过手持触觉界面在多样真实环境中采集，并通过跨本体迁移实验验证其效用。
summary_zh: 大型机器人学习日益依赖于多样化的人类示范，然而触觉操作数据仍难以规模化，且现有的多模态数据集往往缺乏一致的质量控制和结构化监督。我们提出TacClaw-Infinity，一个面向接触密集型操作的大规模结构化视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）数据集，该数据集通过TacClaw采集——一种支持触觉感知的UMI风格手持界面，可在数据采集过程中无需目标机器人即可同步记录视觉观测、指尖触觉信号和末端执行器轨迹。TacClaw-Infinity通过全球分布式采集构建，覆盖家庭、实验室、工业工作场所、零售商店和室外环境，包含由学术和工业合作者贡献的任务。综合这些工作，数据集包含超过10,000小时、100万个片段和10亿帧图像，涵盖超过1,000种任务类型。我们开发了一个可扩展的流水线，用于轨迹重建、多模态质量控制、具身感知过滤和结构化标注，涵盖以接触为中心的语义分割、子任务描述和空间定位。我们在数据层面和模型层面分别验证了TacClaw-Infinity：在数据层面，我们评估了采集界面、精选示范的动作空间兼容性以及结构化标注；在模型层面，我们展示了在无需机器人特定示范的情况下，跨三个异构机器人的跨具身迁移能力。

title: ObjDream: Guiding Vision-Language-Action Models with Object-Level Understanding and Future State Prediction
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling robots to generate actions from visual observations and language instructions. However, most existing VLA models still operate on image-level visual representations inherited from pretrained vision-language backbones, while lacking fine-grained object understanding for manipulation. As a result, their robustness can degrade under out-of-distribution object layouts, clutter, and background variations. To address these limitations, we introduce ObjDream, an object-centric VLA framework centered on object-level understanding and future object state prediction. ObjDream uses a spatio-temporal object encoder to organize visual observations into temporal object slots, where persistent object identity and dynamic object state are represented through separate channels. These structured object representations are inserted into the token sequence of the vision-language model (VLM), where identity-guided routing modulates VLM attention to the corresponding object tokens. In addition, an action-conditioned object dynamics module predicts compact future object states relevant to manipulation during training, explicitly supervising object state evolution under robot actions without requiring future prediction at inference. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 show that ObjDream improves generalization under diverse distribution shifts and scene perturbations. Real-world robot experiments further demonstrate that ObjDream transfers to physical manipulation settings with novel object arrangements and background changes.
tldr: ObjDream is an object-centric VLA framework that uses a spatio-temporal object encoder and action-conditioned future object state prediction to improve generalization in robotic manipulation across distribution shifts and scene perturbations, validated in simulation and real robot experiments.
tldr_zh: ObjDream是一个以对象为中心的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过时空对象编码器和动作条件下的未来对象状态预测，提升了机器人在分布偏移和场景扰动下的泛化能力，并在仿真和真实机器人实验中验证。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人操作领域的一种强大范式，使机器人能够根据视觉观察和语言指令生成动作。然而，现有的大多数VLA模型仍依赖于从预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络中继承的图像级视觉表征，缺乏面向操作所需的细粒度物体理解。因此，在物体布局分布外、场景杂乱以及背景变化等情况下，其鲁棒性可能会下降。为应对这些局限，我们提出了ObjDream——一个以物体级理解和未来物体状态预测为核心的物体中心VLA框架。ObjDream采用时空物体编码器，将视觉观察组织为时间物体槽，其中持续的物体身份和动态物体状态通过独立通道进行表征。这些结构化的物体表征被插入到视觉-语言模型（VLM）的令牌序列中，并通过身份引导路由机制调制VLM注意力，使其聚焦于对应的物体令牌。此外，动作条件物体动力学模块在训练过程中预测与操作相关的紧凑未来物体状态，显式监督机器人动作下物体状态的演化，而无需在推理时进行未来预测。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上的实验表明，ObjDream在多种分布偏移和场景扰动下提升了泛化能力。真实机器人实验进一步证明，ObjDream能够迁移至具有新物体排列和背景变化的物理操作场景中。

title: FoveaVLA: Foveation Actions Replace the Wrist Camera in VLAs
summary: We present FoveaVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions. Wrist cameras provide close-up detail but restrict the view to the end-effector's surroundings. External cameras see the whole scene, but the policy receives them at low resolution, so the fine detail needed for manipulation is lost. FoveaVLA recovers this detail by predicting, alongside each action chunk, the interaction region to observe at the next policy query. The policy then receives crops of these regions, taken from the original-resolution images, together with the full views. We build FoveaVLA on $π_{0.5}$ in two configurations, Single and Dual, using one or two external stereo cameras with full and foveal RGB and depth inputs, and post-train both on DROID with RoboInter interaction annotations. Across four real-world task suites, FoveaVLA-Single achieves 70.8% success with one external RGB-D view, and FoveaVLA-Dual achieves 77.1%, versus 52.1% for the wrist-equipped $π_{0.5}$. Both match the baseline on plain pick-and-place and improve success with distractors, cloth manipulation, and far-away objects.
tldr: FoveaVLA replaces the wrist camera in Vision-Language-Action models with learned foveation actions, predicting interaction regions to crop high-resolution details from external camera images, improving real-world manipulation success across four task suites.
tldr_zh: FoveaVLA 用学习到的注视动作替代腕部相机，通过预测交互区域并从外部相机原始分辨率图像中裁剪细节，提高了多个真实世界操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 我们提出FoveaVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用学习的注视动作替代腕部相机。腕部相机提供特写细节，但将视野限制在执行器末端周围。外部相机能观察整个场景，但策略接收的分辨率较低，因此操作所需的精细细节会丢失。FoveaVLA通过在预测每个动作块的同时，预测下一次策略查询时应观察的交互区域来恢复这些细节。随后，策略接收从原始分辨率图像中裁剪出的这些区域，以及完整视图。我们在π₀.₅基础上构建FoveaVLA的两种配置——单一（Single）和双（Dual），使用一个或两个外部立体相机，包含完整和注视RGB及深度输入，并在带有RoboInter交互标注的DROID数据集上对两种配置进行后训练。在四个真实世界任务套件中，FoveaVLA-Single使用一个外部RGB-D视图达到70.8%的成功率，FoveaVLA-Dual达到77.1%，而配备腕部相机的π₀.₅为52.1%。两种配置在简单拾取放置任务上与基线持平，并在有干扰物、布料操作及远距离物体任务中提升了成功率。

title: Accelerating VLA Inference with Perturbation Informed Execution
summary: Action-chunking vision-language-action (VLA) models predict sequences of future robot actions. Under fixed-horizon execution, the robot executes a fixedlength prefix of each predicted chunk before invoking the policy again, leaving the remaining predictions unused. For a given number of executed actions, short execution horizons require more policy calls. Extending the execution horizon amortizes policy inference cost over more actions. However, uniformly applying long horizons across episodes can limit opportunities for precise corrections. To address this limitation, we propose PICES (Perturbation-Informed Chunk and Execution Horizon Selection), a training-free method that jointly selects an action chunk and the number of actions executed before the next policy call. Within a single policy call, the action expert generates a batch of action chunks from multiple initial noise samples and their locally perturbed counterparts, using the same conditioning features across all samples. PICES exploits differences between corresponding actions in each nominal chunk and its counterpart to determine candidate-specific execution horizons and select a nominal chunk for execution. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that PICES achieves speedup by up to 2.3x in wall-clock policy inference time on Jetson Orin and Thor relative to fixed horizon baselines while improving the success rate.
tldr: PICES is a training-free method that accelerates VLA inference by jointly selecting action chunk lengths and execution horizons based on perturbations, achieving up to 2.3x speedup while improving task success.
tldr_zh: PICES 是一种无需训练的方法，通过基于扰动联合选择动作块长度和执行范围来加速 VLA 推理，在提升任务成功率的同时实现高达 2.3 倍的加速。
summary_zh: 动作分块视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型预测未来机器人动作的序列。在固定时域执行机制下，机器人在再次调用策略之前，仅执行每个预测分块中固定长度的前缀部分，其余预测则被弃用。对于给定数量的已执行动作而言，较短的执行时域需要更多的策略调用次数。延长执行时域可将策略推理成本分摊到更多动作上。然而，在所有回合中统一采用长时域可能会限制进行精确修正的机会。为解决这一局限，我们提出PICES（基于扰动信息的动作分块与执行时域选择）方法，这是一种无需训练的方法，可联合选择动作分块以及在下次策略调用前执行的动作数量。在单次策略调用中，动作专家从多个初始噪声样本及其局部扰动对应样本中生成一批动作分块，所有样本均使用相同的条件特征。PICES利用每个名义分块与其扰动对应分块中相应动作之间的差异，来确定各候选方案特定的执行时域，并选择一个名义分块予以执行。在仿真基准测试和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，与固定时域基线方法相比，PICES在Jetson Orin和Thor平台上实现了高达2.3倍的墙钟策略推理时间加速，同时提升了任务成功率。

title: VLRLA: Deployment-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models through In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. Our approach is also designed for general applicability and compatibility with diverse learning history construction strategies and model training pipelines. Finally, through extensive experiments, we systematically investigate the learning properties of VLRLA in simulation and demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios during real-world deployment.
tldr: This paper introduces VLRLA, a framework for equipping VLA models with in-context reinforcement learning during deployment, allowing policies to adapt and improve task success without parameter updates. Experiments in simulation and real-world demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VLRLA框架，通过在部署阶段为VLA模型赋予上下文强化学习能力，使策略无需更新参数即可逐步适应并提升任务成功率。仿真和真实世界实验验证了其适应未知场景的能力。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉感知与语言理解同机器人控制相连接，为基于指令的操作任务提供了基础支撑。然而，传统预训练的VLA策略缺乏在部署过程中通过积累交互经验实现渐进式适应的机制。为此，我们提出VLRLA，一个通用框架，赋予现有VLA模型在部署阶段具备\textit{上下文强化学习}能力。该方法在VLA模型上增配一个强化学习模块，该模块从历史观测、动作、奖励及终止信号中学习。在部署期间，策略逐步优化其动作生成，并在保持模型参数固定的情况下持续提升任务成功率。本方法还注重通用性与兼容性，可适配多种学习历史构建策略及模型训练流程。最后，通过大量实验，我们在仿真环境中系统考察了VLRLA的学习特性，并展示了其在真实世界部署中适应未见场景的能力。

title: Robota-Embed: Unified VLA Embeddings for Robot In-Context Learning and Evolution
summary: Retrieving useful context for a robot requires matching its task, execution stage, and the continuation that should follow. We introduce Robota-Embed, to our knowledge the first vision-language-action (VLA) embedding model to jointly encode all three modalities in both current-state queries and recorded future continuations. Predictive retrieval training aligns these endpoints, enabling historical continuations to serve as context at inference time. We construct a multi-source corpus of 1,695,684 cleaned training anchors and introduce Robota-Embed-Bench, with 4,000 queries and a shared 8,000-entry gallery. Robota-Embed achieves 47.33% clip-level and 81.77% episode-level R@1, exceeding action-free Gemini Embedding 2 by 22.09 and 33.47 percentage points. Controlled retrieval studies show that removing native action degrades retrieval more than removing vision. We study two complementary applications. Embed2ICL uses retrieved experience for training-free and training-based policy conditioning, increasing success from 47.0% to 56.3% in DROID-Sim and from 86.4% to 92.8% on the LIBERO difficult subset, while improving task progress on real robots. Embed2Evolve uses execution feedback to grow task-local memory and refine context use around a frozen GPT-6 Astra policy. Across five ManiSkill tasks, it achieves 68% success, compared with 24% for GPT-6 Astra Direct and 33% for a harness independently evolved with Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B under the same protocol. Relative to the latter, it uses approximately 79.5% fewer policy tokens per test rollout, counting both successes and failures. These results show that a unified, action-aware retrieval space can support robot in-context learning and task-local context evolution.
tldr: This paper introduces Robota-Embed, the first VLA embedding model that jointly encodes task, execution state, and future actions for retrieval-based robot in-context learning and context evolution. It demonstrates significant improvements in downstream policy performance across simulation and real-robot benchmarks, and enables task-local memory growth around a frozen policy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Robota-Embed，这是首个联合编码任务、执行状态和未来动作的VLA嵌入模型，用于基于检索的机器人上下文学习和上下文进化。实验表明其在仿真和真机基准上显著提升了策略性能，并支持在冻结策略周围增长任务局部记忆。
summary_zh: 检索机器人的有效上下文需要使其与任务、执行阶段以及后续应执行的延续动作相匹配。我们提出了Robota-Embed，据我们所知，这是首个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）嵌入模型，能够在当前状态查询和记录的未来延续中联合编码所有三种模态。预测性检索训练对齐了这些端点，使得历史延续能够在推理时作为上下文使用。我们构建了一个包含1,695,684个清洗后训练锚点的多源语料库，并推出了Robota-Embed-Bench，包含4,000个查询和一个共享的8,000条目图库。Robota-Embed在片段级别达到47.33%的R@1，在情节级别达到81.77%的R@1，分别超过无动作的Gemini Embedding 2达22.09和33.47个百分点。受控检索研究表明，去除原生动作对检索性能的影响大于去除视觉。我们研究了两个互补的应用。Embed2ICL利用检索到的经验进行无需训练和基于训练的策略条件设定，在DROID-Sim中将成功率从47.0%提升至56.3%，在LIBERO困难子集上从86.4%提升至92.8%，同时在真实机器人上提升了任务进度。Embed2Evolve利用执行反馈来扩展任务局部记忆，并围绕冻结的GPT-6 Astra策略优化上下文使用。在五个ManiSkill任务中，它实现了68%的成功率，而GPT-6 Astra Direct为24%，在相同协议下使用Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B独立演化的框架为33%。相对于后者，它在每次测试滚动中使用的策略令牌减少了约79.5%，同时考虑了成功和失败的情况。这些结果表明，统一的、动作感知的检索空间能够支持机器人的上下文学习和任务局部上下文演化。

title: SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are gaining attention in autonomous driving, inheriting commonsense priors from large language models (LLMs) and widening the navigation interface from a fixed command set to free-form natural-language instructions. However, this open-ended interface exposes a new vulnerability surface: an inattentive driver may issue instructions that are unsafe given the current scene, and a malicious user may issue dangerous ones on purpose. We present the first benchmark suite that evaluates navigation following and conflict awareness together, along with adversarial robustness. Existing VLAs fall short on both: SimLingo completes no language-instructed lane change in closed loop, and all models degrade sharply under conflicting signals. We propose SafeDriveVLA, the first driving VLA that (1) explicitly predicts a three-level navigation-compliance mode to decouple conflict reasoning from action generation, and (2) uses navigation-conditioned world model dreaming to inform this prediction. Unlike prior world models that roll out expert or planned actions, ours dreams of strictly following the navigation signal, showing when following is safe. SafeDriveVLA reaches 88.16 Driving Score (DS) and 68.64% Success Rate (SR) on Bench2Drive, lifts closed-loop language following by 49.3% and reduces collisions under unsafe instructions from 60 to 38 compared to the best SimLingo variant. Video demonstrations are available on our project page.
tldr: SafeDriveVLA introduces a navigation-conditioned world model that predicts a three-level navigation-compliance mode to improve conflict awareness and closed-loop language following in end-to-end autonomous driving, demonstrating significant gains on Bench2Drive and reduced collisions under unsafe instructions.
tldr_zh: SafeDriveVLA 提出了一种导航条件的世界模型，用于预测三级导航合规模式，从而提升端到端自动驾驶中的冲突感知和闭环语言跟随能力，在 Bench2Drive 上显著提升并减少不安全指令下的碰撞。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型正受到自动驾驶领域的广泛关注，这类模型继承了大语言模型（LLMs）的常识先验知识，并将导航交互界面从固定的指令集拓展为自由形式的自然语言指令。然而，这种开放性交互界面也暴露了新的安全脆弱面：注意力不集中的驾驶员可能发出在当前场景下存在安全隐患的指令，而恶意用户则可能故意发出危险指令。我们首次提出了一个同时评估导航指令遵循能力、冲突感知能力以及对抗鲁棒性的基准测试套件。现有VLA模型在这两方面均表现不足：SimLingo在闭环测试中无法完成任何语言指令引导的变道操作，且所有模型在冲突信号下性能急剧下降。我们提出了SafeDriveVLA，这是首个（1）显式预测三级导航合规模式以将冲突推理与动作生成解耦，（2）利用导航条件化的世界模型推演来辅助该预测的驾驶VLA模型。与先前基于专家策略或规划动作进行推演的世界模型不同，我们的模型推演严格遵循导航信号的情形，从而判断何时遵循导航指令是安全的。SafeDriveVLA在Bench2Drive基准上取得了88.16的驾驶评分（DS）和68.64%的成功率（SR），闭环语言指令跟随能力提升49.3%，并在不安全指令下将碰撞次数从60次降至38次，优于最优的SimLingo变体。视频演示可在我们的项目页面查看。

title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/
tldr: This paper applies latent diffusion to model the weight distribution of humanoid control policies, generating deployable networks for real-world Unitree G1 motions and revealing a kinematic prior in first-layer weights.
tldr_zh: 本文使用潜在扩散模型对人形机器人控制策略的权重分布进行建模，生成可在真实Unitree G1上部署的网络，并揭示了第一层权重中的运动学先验。
summary_zh: 近年来，机器人学习领域的进展推动了人形机器人控制的快速发展，使其在现实世界中展现出日益敏捷的行为能力。然而，人形控制网络通常通过传统训练流程获得，而直接对其学习到的权重分布进行建模并在权重空间中生成功能性网络的研究则相对较少。在本工作中，我们探讨是否能够直接通过权重对人形机器人高性能控制网络进行生成式建模。我们采用了一种潜在扩散框架，将线性自编码器与扩散Transformer相结合。自编码器将演员网络参数压缩至紧凑的潜在空间，扩散Transformer则对这些潜在变量的分布进行建模。该框架在针对宇树G1机器人通过强化学习收集的网络数据上进行训练，所生成的可部署网络能够在现实世界中执行多种动作，包括行走、舞蹈和旋转踢腿。除生成功能外，我们进一步研究了所学习的权重空间，以更深入地理解这些人形控制网络所捕获的结构特征。我们发现了第一层权重中一个结构性原则，该原则一致地反映了机器人运动学的先验知识。值得注意的是，这一运动学先验在强化学习（RL）和模仿学习（IL）训练中均会出现，表明它并非特定于某种优化过程，而可能反映了与人形本体相关的共性知识。综上，这些结果证明了在人形网络权重空间中进行生成式建模的可行性，同时为理解其学习权重所编码的信息提供了初步见解。更多结果请访问我们的项目网站：https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/

title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
summary: Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) is a cornerstone of autonomous robotic systems, yet real-world fine-tuning remains a formidable challenge because of high-dimensional action spaces and intricate coupling between heterogeneous modules. In this paper, we propose HiRe-MoMa (Hierarchical Residual Mobile Manipulation), a systematic framework for stable and sample-efficient real-world fine-tuning of complex MoMa systems. At its core, HiRe-MoMa adopts a Hierarchical Residual Architecture that fine-tunes a frozen base policy. A Policy-Agnostic Residual learns additive corrections atop the base policy, while Hierarchical Decoupling splits the residual into mobile-base and manipulator-arm heads with unidirectional conditioning, mitigating gradient interference and aligning corrections with the platform's physical hierarchy. To improve sample efficiency in data-expensive real-world settings, we propose Expert-Guided Value Alignment, which leverages sparse human interventions with under 20% training coverage to reshape the critic's value landscape, effectively guiding autonomous exploration through expert priors. Extensive real-world experiments on the TIAGo++ platform demonstrate that HiRe-MoMa consistently enhances task performance with only around 30 minutes of online interaction, regardless of the base policy architecture. To our knowledge, this is among the first frameworks to enable efficient on-robot fine-tuning for mobile manipulation in the real world, providing a practical paradigm for deploying complex robotic systems in dynamic, human-centric environments. Further details can be found on our project website: https://hire-moma.github.io/
tldr: HiRe-MoMa introduces a hierarchical residual learning framework for sample-efficient real-world fine-tuning of mobile manipulation policies, using sparse human interventions to guide value alignment.
tldr_zh: HiRe-MoMa 提出了一种分层残差学习框架，通过稀疏的人类干预引导价值对齐，实现移动操纵策略在真实世界中的高效微调。
summary_zh: 移动操作（MoMa）是自主机器人系统的基石，然而，由于高维动作空间以及异构模块之间复杂的耦合关系，现实世界中的微调仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了HiRe-MoMa（Hierarchical Residual Mobile Manipulation，分层残差移动操作），这是一个系统化框架，用于实现对复杂MoMa系统进行稳定且样本高效的真实世界微调。其核心在于，HiRe-MoMa采用了一种分层残差架构，对冻结的基础策略进行微调。策略无关残差模块在基础策略之上学习加性修正，而分层解耦模块则将残差分解为移动基座与机械臂两个头，并通过单向条件约束，从而减轻梯度干扰并使修正与平台的物理层级结构保持一致。为了在数据获取成本高昂的真实环境中提升样本效率，我们提出了专家引导的价值对齐方法，该方法利用覆盖率不足20%的稀疏人工干预来重塑评论者的价值景观，从而通过专家先验有效引导自主探索。在TIAGo++平台上进行的大量真实世界实验表明，无论基础策略架构如何，HiRe-MoMa仅需约30分钟的在线交互即可持续提升任务性能。据我们所知，这是首批能够在真实世界中实现移动操作机器人高效在线微调的框架之一，为在动态、以人为中心的环境中部署复杂机器人系统提供了实用的范式。更多详细信息，请访问我们的项目网站：https://hire-moma.github.io/

title: PingpongDuo: Agile Humanoid Table Tennis Doubles with Safe Team Coordination
summary: Unlike singles, humanoid table tennis doubles requires teammates to strike in strict alternation while sharing a confined workspace. Rapid repositioning can compromise striking accuracy, while uncoordinated teammate movements introduce collision risks. We present PingpongDuo, a hierarchical framework for agile humanoid doubles with safe team coordination. At the team level, a planner jointly selects positioning targets and uses learned risk estimates to filter risky proposals, preferentially preserving the current striker's target. At the individual level, separate footwork and striking skills combine agile movement with precise racket control. The skills are guided by human motion references, including footwork collected from human doubles play, and trained from states produced by one another to support rapid transitions. A racket-arm residual further refines strikes after movement using return feedback from a simulator calibrated with real ball-flight and contact measurements. In simulation, PingpongDuo improves the ball-return success rate by 13.2% over the state-of-the-art baseline, while achieving approximately 2 cm positioning error during clearance. In real-world experiments, a robot completes a 2.15 m clearance-and-recovery cycle in 2.4 s with a peak speed of 2.23 m/s, while two robots sustain more than 10 consecutive strikes in strict alternation.
tldr: PingpongDuo presents a hierarchical framework enabling agile humanoid table tennis doubles with safe team coordination, combining joint planning with risk filtering, human-guided footwork/striking skills, and sim-calibrated residual refinement, achieving a 13.2% success rate improvement over baseline in simulation and sustained 10+ alternating strikes on real robots.
tldr_zh: PingpongDuo 提出了一种分层框架，通过联合规划与风险过滤、人类动作引导的步伐与击球技能以及基于仿真校准的残差修正，实现了敏捷且安全协作的人形机器人乒乓球双打，在仿真中成功率提升13.2%，并在真实机器人上实现了连续10次以上交替击球。
summary_zh: 不同于单打，人形机器人乒乓球双打要求队友在共享的有限工作空间内严格交替击球。快速 repositioning 可能牺牲击球精度，而队友间不协调的移动则会带来碰撞风险。我们提出了 PingpongDuo，一个面向敏捷人形双打的安全团队协调层次化框架。在团队层面，规划器联合选择定位目标，并利用学习得到的风险评估过滤高风险方案，优先保留当前击球者的目标。在个体层面，独立的步法与击球技能相结合，实现敏捷移动与精准拍控的统一。这些技能以人类运动参考为引导，包括从人类双打比赛中采集的步法数据，并由彼此生成的状态进行训练，以支持快速转换。击球手臂的残差模块利用经过真实球飞行与接触测量标定的仿真器反馈，在移动后进一步优化击球。在仿真中，PingpongDuo 相较现有最优基线将回球成功率提升了 13.2%，同时在避让过程中的定位误差约为 2 厘米。在真实世界实验中，一台机器人在 2.4 秒内完成 2.15 米的避让-恢复循环，峰值速度达 2.23 米/秒，而两台机器人能够以严格交替方式连续击球超过 10 次。

title: KinoGen: Customizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation References via Kinematically Grounded Video Generation
summary: We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen conditions a pretrained video generator on calibrated renders of the target robot and object in a simulated task instance and recovers the reference by fitting the same models to the generated two-view video, so that the reference lies in the robot configuration space by construction without a human body proxy or retargeting. Body, hand, and object priors initialize the reconstruction, and direct optimization against cross-view evidence refines it. Since an edited keyframe is simply another rendered state, a user can prescribe a goal object pose, regenerate the video around the edited keyframe, and obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly. Across eight loco-manipulation tasks, KinoGen yields lower penetration and foot skating than video-based baselines and preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and its customized references satisfy every prescribed target with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Tracking policies trained on the synthesized references are deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands. Project webpage: https://kinogen-humanoid.github.io/.
tldr: KinoGen synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references by conditioning a pretrained video generator on robot/object renders and recovering kinematically valid poses from generated two-view video, enabling exact user-specified goal poses and producing deployable tracking policies on a real humanoid.
tldr_zh: KinoGen 通过将预训练视频生成器以机器人/物体的渲染图像为条件，从生成的双视角视频中恢复运动学有效的姿态，从而合成可定制的人形移动操作参考，支持精确的用户指定目标姿态，并在真实人形机器人上部署跟踪策略。
summary_zh: 我们提出了KinoGen框架，该框架通过基于运动学约束的视频生成来合成可定制的人形移动操作参考。KinoGen以目标机器人和物体在模拟任务实例中的校准渲染为条件，对预训练的视频生成器进行调控，并通过将相同模型拟合到生成的双视角视频来恢复参考，从而使得参考在构造上即处于机器人构型空间内，无需人体代理或重定向。人体、手部及物体先验用于初始化重建，并通过直接优化跨视角证据进行细化。由于编辑后的关键帧仅仅是另一个渲染状态，用户可以指定目标物体姿态，围绕编辑后的关键帧重新生成视频，并获得完全满足该姿态的参考。在八项移动操作任务中，KinoGen相比基于视频的基线方法实现了更低的穿透率和脚部滑动，并保留了超过90%的标注接触；其定制参考完全满足所有指定目标，且穿透率显著低于直接插值方法。基于合成参考训练出的跟踪策略已部署在配备灵巧手的Unitree G1人形机器人上。项目网页：https://kinogen-humanoid.github.io/。

title: Physical Time as a Missing Dimension of Robot Policy Memory Dynamics
summary: Existing robot policy memories typically evolve with observation sequences, implicitly treating each update as the same amount of physical time. Yet identical observation histories can span different durations and require different actions, exposing physical time as a missing dimension of policy memory. We introduce Temporal Flow Policy (TFP), which learns memory dynamics to retain past events and evolve the memory state over measured time intervals. Observations and prior memory determine the content and time scales of each transition; elapsed time determines how far the state advances. TFP conditions diffusion and flow-matching policies through this memory state and is trained with their native imitation objectives. We evaluate TFP with Diffusion Policy and $π_{0.5}$ through controlled comparisons of memory designs. These experiments show that successful timing depends on both measured intervals and retained history. TFP achieves higher average success than the recurrent and state-space memories we equip with the same intervals and than a variant that feeds the interval to a learned gate. Memory readouts recover the time since an event and motion information after occlusion. Changing the supplied intervals systematically delays or advances actions, linking time inputs to behavior. Real-robot tasks requiring timing or memory, together with LIBERO evaluations, demonstrate benefits in physical and general manipulation. These results suggest viewing robot memory not as stored observation history, but as a state that retains past events and evolves with physical time.
tldr: This paper introduces Temporal Flow Policy (TFP), which treats physical time as a dimension of robot policy memory, using measured time intervals to evolve memory states. TFP improves timing and memory-dependent manipulation tasks over existing recurrent and state-space memory approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出时间流策略（TFP），将物理时间作为机器人策略记忆的一个维度，利用测量时间间隔来演化记忆状态。TFP在需要时序和记忆的操控任务上优于现有循环和状态空间记忆方法。
summary_zh: 现有机器人策略记忆通常随观测序列演化，隐式地将每次更新视为相同的物理时间量。然而，相同的观测历史可能跨越不同的时间长度并需要不同的动作，这揭示出物理时间是策略记忆中缺失的一个维度。我们提出了时间流策略（Temporal Flow Policy, TFP），该方法学习记忆动态以保留过去事件，并在实测时间间隔内演化记忆状态。观测与先前的记忆决定每次转移的内容和时间尺度；经过的时间决定状态推进的距离。TFP通过该记忆状态条件化扩散策略和流匹配策略，并使用其原生模仿目标进行训练。我们通过记忆设计的受控比较，将TFP与Diffusion Policy和$π_{0.5}$进行对比评估。实验表明，成功的时间控制同时依赖于实测时间间隔和保留的历史信息。TFP在平均成功率上优于我们配备相同时间间隔的循环记忆和状态空间记忆，也优于将时间间隔输入到学习门的变体。记忆读出能够恢复遮挡后的事件发生时间及运动信息。改变输入的时间间隔会系统地延迟或提前动作，将时间输入与行为联系起来。需要时间控制或记忆的真实机器人任务，以及LIBERO评估，展示了在物理操作和通用操作中的优势。这些结果表明，机器人记忆不应被视为存储的观测历史，而应被视为一种保留过去事件并随物理时间演化的状态。

title: Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning with Human Interventions for Precise Robotic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon precise manipulation produces mixed-quality data for post-training vision-language-action (VLA) models: even successful demonstrations and intervention-assisted rollouts may contain detours, hesitations, failed attempts, and imperfect recoveries. The key challenge is to identify which action chunks actually advance the task, rather than uniformly cloning or discarding imperfect trajectories. We propose Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning (GR-BC), an offline iterative post-training framework that builds a task-conditioned goal-reachability graph over demonstrations and iteratively collected rollouts, including both successful and failed episodes with human interventions. Reverse graph search computes minimal remaining steps to task success within the dataset support, and each action chunk is weighted by how much its execution reduces this potential. This consequence-based weighting reuses recoverable segments from failed trajectories, leverages interventions as recovery paths, and down-weights locally regressive chunks even inside successful trajectories. New rollouts are incorporated by appending them to the graph and rerunning search, without training a reward model, action-conditioned critic, or progress predictor. Across four precise manipulation tasks and three VLA backbones, GR-BC improves single-round supervised fine-tuning and reaches 91% success after a few offline iterations, without trajectory comparisons or progress labels. More details and videos are available at: https://gr-bc.github.io
tldr: GR-BC is an offline iterative post-training framework that reweights action chunks in VLA trajectories using graph search to estimate goal-reachability, improving robot manipulation success without reward models or progress labels.
tldr_zh: GR-BC 是一种离线迭代后训练框架，通过图搜索估计目标可达性对 VLA 轨迹中的动作块重新加权，在无需奖励模型或进度标签的情况下提升机器人操作成功率。
summary_zh: 长时程精细操作在为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型生成用于后训练的数据时，往往会产生质量参差不齐的轨迹数据：即便是成功的示范数据或带有人工干预的回放数据，也可能包含绕路、犹豫、失败尝试以及不完美的恢复过程。关键在于如何识别出哪些动作片段真正推动了任务进展，而非对不完美轨迹进行统一克隆或直接丢弃。为此，我们提出图重加权行为克隆方法（Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning，简称GR-BC），一种离线迭代式的后训练框架，它在示范数据与迭代收集的回放数据（包括成功与失败片段，及带有人工干预的回合）之上构建任务条件的目标可达性图。通过反向图搜索，可在数据集支撑范围内计算到达任务成功所需的最短剩余步数，并将每个动作片段按其执行对该潜力的缩减程度赋予权重。这种基于结果影响的加权方式能够复用失败轨迹中可恢复的片段，将人工干预作为恢复路径加以利用，同时即便在成功轨迹中也能对局部回退型片段进行降权处理。新增回放数据可追加到图中并重新执行搜索，而无需训练奖励模型、动作条件评估器或进度预测器。在四个精细操作任务和三种VLA骨干网络上，GR-BC相较单轮监督微调均有所提升，并在数轮离线迭代后达到91%的成功率，全程无需轨迹对比或进度标签。更多细节与视频请参见：https://gr-bc.github.io

title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.
tldr: AdaRSI is an on-demand recursive self-improvement framework for embodied agents that selectively fine-tunes a vision-language-action model only for persistently failing sub-steps, improving success on unseen RoboCasa tasks while reducing GPU time and demonstrations.
tldr_zh: AdaRSI 是一种用于具身代理的按需递归自我改进框架，仅针对持续失败的子步骤对视觉-语言-动作模型进行微调，在提升未见过的 RoboCasa 任务成功率的同时，减少了 GPU 时间和演示数据。
summary_zh: 预训练视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在未见过的长时程任务中常常会中途失败。递归自我改进（RSI）提供了一种补救措施，但具身RSI方法要么在冻结的执行器周围优化调用框架，因而无法补充缺失的动作，要么在训练执行器时仅针对持续失败进行训练，却不探究失败的原因究竟是执行器的调用方式还是其能力边界。我们探讨了自我改进的具身系统应在何时调整其执行器的权重，并提出了AdaRSI——一种面向具身智能体的按需RSI框架。编码智能体首先提升自身技能和调用框架，随后通过从已保存状态重试失败的子步骤来归因持续性失败，并仅对仍不可靠的子步骤进行微调，所使用的示范由智能体自身收集，并继承先前任务的经验。在RoboCasa365全部50个目标任务中，以GR00T N1.5为执行器且无人工示范的情况下，AdaRSI在全部三个测试套件上均提升了VLA的性能，并将未见过的复合任务成功率从4.6%提升至13.8%。与对所有子步骤进行微调相比，AdaRSI在取得略高成功率的同时，仅使用了28%的GPU时间和22%的自收集示范；而未使用调用框架的微调虽然训练量更大，但增益却明显更少。

title: AutoRSR: Automated Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Generation for Scalable Robot Learning
summary: Scaling embodied robot learning requires large and diverse manipulation datasets, but collecting real-world demonstrations remains expensive in human effort and robot time. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, yet converting a real workspace into a robot-learning-ready environment still requires substantial manual effort for object extraction, asset processing, coordinate calibration, and trajectory specification. We present AutoRSR, a highly automated real-to-sim-to real framework that converts scanned real-world workspaces into reusable embodied simulation assets and scalable manipulation data. Given multi-view observations, robot states, and open-vocabulary semantic queries, AutoRSR reconstructs the workspace, extracts individual object assets, and automatically registers the reconstructed scene to the robot base frame at metric scale. Starting from a small number of reference motions, AutoRSR then generates executable manipulation trajectories and scales them through trajectory interpolation and domain randomization. After workspace scanning and semantic queries, the remaining pipeline requires no manual object annotation, scene-to-robot calibration, or robot teleoperation. Across three real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained on 1K automatically generated episodes per task achieve 73.3--86.7% real-world success rates, comparable to pi 0.5 trained from 150 human teleoperated demonstrations, while reducing the human time required for data generation by an order of magnitude. These results demonstrate that real-world observations can be converted into metrically aligned, executable, and scalable simulation data with substantially reduced human effort.
tldr: AutoRSR automates the conversion of scanned real-world workspaces into executable simulation assets and scalable manipulation data using multi-view observations and semantic queries, achieving real-world success rates comparable to human-teleoperated training with an order of magnitude less human effort.
tldr_zh: AutoRSR利用多视角观测和语义查询，将扫描的真实工作空间自动转换为可执行的仿真资产生成可扩展的操纵数据，在十倍减少人力的情况下达到与人类遥操作训练相当的真实世界成功率。
summary_zh: 扩展具身机器人学习需要大规模且多样化的操作数据集，但采集真实世界示范在人力投入和机器人时间方面仍然代价高昂。仿真提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，然而将真实工作空间转换为机器人学习就绪环境仍需大量人工操作，包括对象提取、资产处理、坐标校准和轨迹指定。我们提出AutoRSR，一种高度自动化的“真实到仿真再到真实”框架，可将扫描所得的真实工作空间转换为可复用的具身仿真资产和可扩展的操作数据。给定多视角观测、机器人状态和开放词汇语义查询，AutoRSR能够重建工作空间、提取单个对象资产，并自动将重建场景以公制尺度配准到机器人基座坐标系。从少量参考动作出发，AutoRSR随后生成可执行的操作轨迹，并通过轨迹插值和域随机化进行扩展。在工作空间扫描和语义查询之后，其余流程无需人工对象标注、场景-机器人标定或机器人遥操作。在三个真实世界操作任务中，基于每任务自动生成的1000条轨迹训练的策略在真实环境中实现了73.3%至86.7%的成功率，与基于150条人工遥操作示范训练的pi 0.5相当，同时将数据生成所需的人工时间减少了一个数量级。这些结果表明，真实世界观测可以被转换为度量对齐、可执行且可扩展的仿真数据，并显著降低人工投入。

title: VIGOR-MPC: Vision-Guided Objective Regulation MPC
summary: Controlling an agent in an environment solely perceived through onboard vision is challenging: perception yields noisy, variable-length, and partially occluded context, while onboard compute is shared between perception and control, limiting the planning horizon executable in real time. We propose VIGOR-MPC, a modular student-teacher framework, agnostic to the perception pipeline, which addresses reference tracking across navigation tasks by distilling a privileged, field-of-view-aware long-horizon MPC into a computationally lightweight short-horizon MPC whose cost parameters are determined online from vision. The teacher operates in simulation with full state knowledge and a multi-trajectory formulation that guarantees the agent can stay within its field of view. The student observes only the noisy, occluded context produced by a perception module and learns, via a multi-level recurrent mapping, to infer cost parameters that aim to recover the teacher's behavior despite missing information. We evaluate VIGOR-MPC on vision-based autonomous racing in simulation and on hardware. Using only onboard perception of the track, VIGOR-MPC generalizes to tracks unseen during training and approaches the lap times of the privileged long-horizon teacher while reducing per-step computation by over 90%.
tldr: VIGOR-MPC introduces a modular student-teacher framework that distills a privileged long-horizon MPC into a lightweight vision-based MPC for autonomous racing, achieving near-teacher performance with over 90% computation reduction.
tldr_zh: VIGOR-MPC提出了一种模块化的学生-教师框架，将特权长时域MPC蒸馏为基于视觉的轻量级MPC，用于自动驾驶赛车，在计算量减少90%以上的同时接近教师性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：仅通过机载视觉感知环境来控制智能体颇具挑战性：感知产生噪声大、长度可变且部分遮挡的上下文信息，而机载计算资源需在感知与控制之间共享，限制了实时可执行的规划时域。我们提出VIGOR-MPC，一种模块化的师生框架，对感知流程不可知，通过将特权化的、视野感知的长时域MPC蒸馏为计算上轻量化的短时域MPC来解决跨导航任务的参考跟踪问题，其代价参数由视觉在线确定。教师模型在仿真中以完整状态知识和多轨迹公式运行，保证智能体能够保持在其视野范围内。学生模型仅观察感知模块产生的带噪声、被遮挡的上下文，并通过多层次循环映射学习推断代价参数，以在信息缺失的情况下恢复教师模型的行为。我们在仿真和硬件上对基于视觉的自动驾驶竞速任务评估了VIGOR-MPC。仅使用机载赛道感知，VIGOR-MPC即可泛化到训练中未见过的赛道，并在将每步计算量减少超过90%的同时，接近特权化长时域教师模型的单圈时间。

title: Learning Navigation from Multimodal Demonstrations with Geometric Candidate Modes
summary: Offline navigation demonstrations are multimodal, because one observation often allows several valid actions, such as passing an obstacle on either side. Behavior cloning averages these actions, potentially leading to unsafe routes. Multimodal policies must discover the alternatives from the data, but similar states can lead to different routes whose current actions overlap. In navigation, the alternatives have a geometric cause and can be computed from one observation. We propose a hierarchical neural-network policy that computes candidate modes from local geometry and learns from demonstrations which mode to follow and how. A high-level policy selects a mode using the goal and its previous choice among a set of candidate modes, and a low-level policy turns it into an action. In simulation, the policy succeeds in over 95\% of seen and unseen test cases, compared with at most 43\% and 20\% for four offline learning baselines and 79\% and 67\% for a heuristic that uses the same modes without learning. The simulation-trained policy also transfers to a LimX Tron 1 bipedal robot.
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical multimodal navigation policy that computes candidate modes from local geometry and learns to select among them, achieving high success in simulation and transferring to a bipedal robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种层次化多模态导航策略，从局部几何计算候选模式并学习选择，在仿真中取得高成功率并迁移到双足机器人。
summary_zh: 离线导航演示是多模态的，因为一个观测往往允许多种有效动作，例如从障碍物的任一侧通过。行为克隆会对这些动作取平均，可能导致不安全的路径。多模态策略必须从数据中发现这些替代方案，但相似的状态可能导向当前动作重叠的不同路线。在导航中，这些替代方案具有几何原因，并可以从单次观测中计算得出。我们提出了一种层次化神经网络策略，该策略从局部几何中计算候选模式，并从演示中学习该遵循哪种模式以及如何遵循。高层策略利用目标及其在一组候选模式中的先前选择来选定一个模式，而低层策略则将其转化为动作。在仿真中，该策略在可见和未见过的测试案例中均取得了超过95%的成功率，相比之下，四种离线学习基线的成功率最多分别为43%和20%，而一种未经过学习、使用相同模式的启发式方法的成功率分别为79%和67%。该仿真训练的策略还成功迁移到了LimX Tron 1双足机器人上。

title: Investigating Behavior Cloning from Few Demonstrations for Autonomous Driving based on Bird's-Eye View in Simulated Cities
summary: This paper investigates the use of Behavior Cloning (BC) for autonomous driving from a bird's-eye view (BEV) perspective in simulated urban environments. BC uses supervised learning to mimic expert driving behaviors. Previous works have applied BC in the CARLA simulator but did not fully address the challenges of traffic light compliance. Our approach enhances BC by integrating a kernel density estimator to adjust training sample weights based on action density, thereby improving the learning of rare but critical actions such as stopping at red lights and accelerating at green lights, specially in scenarios of scarce number of expert demonstrations. Using BEV inputs, which provide an abstract top-down view of the driving environment, our method simplifies the policy learning process. The trained convolutional neural network (CNN) outputs steering and acceleration actions based on these BEV inputs and additional state variables. Experimental results in the CARLA simulator demonstrate that our weighted BC method significantly improves driving performance, achieving higher route completion compared to standard BC. This weighted approach proved to be crucial in learning correct driving behaviors, particularly in test environments not encountered during training, highlighting its potential for enhancing autonomous vehicle navigation.
tldr: This paper proposes a weighted behavior cloning approach for autonomous driving in CARLA, using kernel density estimation on action distribution to improve learning of rare critical behaviors like traffic light compliance from few demonstrations with bird's-eye view inputs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于核密度估计的加权行为克隆方法，用于CARLA仿真中的自动驾驶，通过调整训练样本权重来改进从少量专家演示中学习红绿灯等稀有关键行为的能力，并使用鸟瞰图作为输入。
summary_zh: 本文探讨了在模拟城市环境中，从鸟瞰视角（BEV）出发，利用行为克隆（BC）技术实现自动驾驶的方法。行为克隆通过监督学习来模仿专家的驾驶行为。以往的研究虽已在CARLA模拟器中应用BC，但并未充分解决交通信号灯合规性的挑战。我们的方法通过集成核密度估计器，根据动作密度调整训练样本权重，从而增强对稀少但关键动作的学习，如红灯停车和绿灯加速，尤其在专家演示样本稀缺的情境下更为显著。利用BEV输入，其提供了驾驶环境的抽象俯视图，简化了策略学习过程。训练得到的卷积神经网络（CNN）基于这些BEV输入及附加状态变量，输出转向和加速指令。在CARLA模拟器中的实验结果表明，我们的加权BC方法显著提升了驾驶性能，实现了比标准BC更高的路线完成率。该加权方法在学习正确驾驶行为方面至关重要，特别是在训练中未遇到的新测试环境中，凸显了其在增强自动驾驶车辆导航能力方面的潜力。

title: Atomic-WAM: Execution-Grounded Atomic-Motion Reasoning for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) typically adapt video foundation models to robotic control through joint video and action prediction. However, task-level instructions may leave the next physical interaction underspecified, requiring semantic grounding and state-dependent motion selection. To this end, we introduce Atomic-WAM, an understand-then-execute framework that connects task reasoning to action generation through atomic-motion descriptions. Specifically, a vision-language reasoner describes the next local motion from the task instruction and visual context, guiding a WAM to predict future video and an action chunk. Furthermore, an automatic annotation pipeline curates temporally aligned, contact-enriched supervision from multi-view DROID demonstrations. To make atomic-motion predictions executable by the WAM, we post-train the reasoner with Execution-Grounded GRPO (EG-GRPO). With the WAM fixed, EG-GRPO adapts the reasoner through rewards for motion appropriateness and execution success. Finally, Atomic-WAM achieves 39.6% task success under default instructions and 31.6% under vague instructions in a real-to-sim evaluation on RoboLab. Project page: https://ssj9596.github.io/Atomic-WAM-project
tldr: Atomic-WAM introduces an understand-then-execute framework for World Action Models, where a vision-language reasoner generates atomic-motion descriptions to guide future video and action prediction, trained via Execution-Grounded GRPO to improve task success under vague instructions.
tldr_zh: Atomic-WAM 提出了一种先理解后执行的框架，用于世界行动模型，其中视觉语言推理器生成原子运动描述以指导未来视频和动作预测，并通过执行接地 GRPO 训练以提高模糊指令下的任务成功率。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通常通过联合视频与动作预测，将视频基础模型适配至机器人控制任务。然而，任务级指令可能无法充分明确下一步物理交互，需要语义 grounding 与状态相关动作选择。为此，我们提出 Atomic-WAM，一种“先理解后执行”的框架，通过原子动作描述将任务推理与动作生成相连接。具体而言，视觉-语言推理器从任务指令与视觉上下文中描述下一步局部动作，引导 WAM 预测未来视频及动作块。此外，我们设计了一条自动标注流水线，从多视角 DROID 演示中提取时间对齐且富含接触信息的监督信号。为使原子动作预测可由 WAM 执行，我们采用执行锚定 GRPO（EG-GRPO）对推理器进行后训练。在 WAM 固定不变的情况下，EG-GRPO 根据动作适当性与执行成功的奖励信号对推理器进行适配。最终，在 RoboLab 的真实到仿真评估中，Atomic-WAM 在默认指令下达到 39.6% 的任务成功率，在模糊指令下达到 31.6%。项目主页：https://ssj9596.github.io/Atomic-WAM-project

title: HM3D-M3: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent, Multi-Modal, Multi-Object Goal Navigation
summary: Rapid progress in AI agents and robotics makes it a matter of the near future that humans are served by a team of robots. Such a team will receive several goals at once, each specified in whatever form is convenient for the human, such as a category name, a photo, or a spoken description. Existing benchmarks study multi-agent, multi-modal, and multi-object goal navigation in isolation, and a benchmark that places all three in one episode is missing. To fill this gap, we introduce HM3D-M3. A team of K agents starts at distributed locations in a photorealistic indoor scene and searches for an unordered set of M object goals, each given as an open-vocabulary category, an instance image, or an instance description. HM3D-M3 provides 1,000 validation episodes over 3,926 goals from 379 open-vocabulary categories, 100K observation-assignment training samples, and two team-level metrics, goal-level SR and makespan-normalized SPL. We further contribute two baselines. HiGA is a trained hierarchical goal assigner on top of a frozen open-vocabulary navigation policy, and LaViRA-M3 is a training-free team of VLM agents with shared mapping and progress analysis. Adapted multi-robot and zero-shot methods reach 16--27% SR, while our baselines reach 38--41% with complementary strengths and distinct failure modes. Furthermore, we deploy LaViRA-M3 on a heterogeneous three-robot team. Project page: https://robo-lavira.github.io/hm3d-m3/
tldr: This paper introduces HM3D-M3, a benchmark for multi-agent, multi-modal, multi-object goal navigation in photorealistic indoor scenes, along with two baselines (HiGA and LaViRA-M3) that achieve state-of-the-art performance on the benchmark. The benchmark and baselines are designed to advance research towards teams of robots that can execute multiple natural-language, image, or category-specified goals concurrently.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HM3D-M3，一个用于真实感室内场景中多智能体、多模态、多目标导航的基准测试，并提供了两个基线方法（HiGA和LaViRA-M3），在基准上取得了最佳性能。该基准和基线旨在推动面向能够并发执行多种自然语言、图像或类别指定目标的机器人团队的研究。
summary_zh: 人工智能体与机器人技术的迅猛发展，使得由机器人团队为人类提供服务即将成为现实。这样一个团队将同时接收多个目标，每个目标以方便人类的任意形式给出，例如类别名称、照片或语音描述。现有基准测试分别研究多智能体、多模态和多目标导航，但尚无一个基准测试将这三者置于同一任务场景中。为填补这一空白，我们提出了HM3D-M3。由K个智能体组成的团队从真实感室内场景中的不同位置出发，搜索一组无序的M个物体目标，每个目标以开放词汇类别、实例图像或实例描述的形式给出。HM3D-M3提供了1,000个验证场景，涵盖来自379个开放词汇类别的3,926个目标，100,000个观察-分配训练样本，以及两个团队级指标：目标级成功率（SR）和以完工时间归一化的SPL。我们还贡献了两个基线方法。HiGA是一种基于冻结的开放词汇导航策略之上训练的分层目标分配器，而LaViRA-M3是一种无需训练的多模态大语言模型（VLM）智能体团队，具备共享地图和进度分析能力。改编的多机器人和零样本方法达到16%-27%的成功率，而我们的基线方法达到38%-41%的成功率，且具有互补优势和不同的失败模式。此外，我们将LaViRA-M3部署到了一个异构三机器人团队上。项目页面：https://robo-lavira.github.io/hm3d-m3/

title: MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In
summary: Progress toward general intelligence in the physical world requires scaling robot learning across diverse environments and interactions. However, existing robot policies use shared parameters that remain fixed across interaction contexts. When different operations favor competing parameter adjustments, fitting their mixture can leave individual operations insufficiently adapted. Our atomic-task diagnostics reveal competing update directions in both vision-language and action parameters, with source-improving updates increasing loss on other tasks. This motivates MorphAct, a contextual parameterization framework that dynamically adjusts robot policy parameters as interaction contexts change. Two coupled generators produce context-dependent low-rank updates for the vision-language and action modules. Their coupling follows the policy's computational dependency: vision-language updates shape the representations that condition action-side parameter generation. Both generators are trained jointly through the native action objective, without operation labels or expert-adapter targets. MorphAct improves performance across three VLA backbones on LIBERO and Meta-World, with gains of up to 16.30%. In real-world evaluation, it achieves gains of up to 14% over $π_{0.5}$. Ablations support the benefits of contextual parameter generation and representation coupling.
tldr: MorphAct introduces a contextual parameterization framework that dynamically adapts VLA model parameters based on interaction context, improving performance on simulated and real robot manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MorphAct 提出一种上下文参数化框架，根据交互上下文动态调整 VLA 模型参数，在仿真和真实机器人操作基准上提升了性能。
summary_zh: 在物理世界中实现通用智能的进展，要求在多样化的环境和交互中扩展机器人学习。然而，现有的机器人策略使用共享参数，这些参数在交互情境中保持不变。当不同操作偏好相互竞争的参数调整时，拟合它们的混合体可能导致个别操作适应不足。我们的原子任务诊断揭示了视觉-语言和动作参数中相互竞争的更新方向，其中源改进更新会增加其他任务的损失。这促使我们提出MorphAct，一种情境参数化框架，能够根据交互情境的变化动态调整机器人策略参数。两个耦合的生成器为视觉-语言和动作模块生成依赖情境的低秩更新。它们的耦合遵循策略的计算依赖关系：视觉-语言的更新塑造了用于条件化动作侧参数生成的表示。两个生成器通过原生动作目标进行联合训练，无需操作标签或专家适配器目标。MorphAct在LIBERO和Meta-World上提升了三个VLA骨干网络的性能，提升幅度最高达16.30%。在真实世界评估中，相较于$π_{0.5}$，其性能提升最高达14%。消融实验支持了情境参数生成和表示耦合的益处。

title: Complementary Future Token Pruning for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict future visual states and robot actions, but processing dense future-frame tokens incurs substantial inference latency. We propose CF-Prune, a training-free framework for pruning future-frame tokens in pretrained WAMs. Our key insight is that future visual predictions support action generation and therefore need not preserve every visual detail required for high-fidelity video synthesis. CF-Prune combines instruction and action attention to identify task-relevant tokens during the initial denoising forward pass, even when future-frame and action representations remain highly noisy. An entropy-based phase identification mechanism further retains dense computation during precision phases to mitigate pruning-induced performance degradation. Experiments on RoboLab, RoboCasa, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate consistent inference speedups. At a 35% pruning ratio, CF-Prune achieves average speedups of 1.19-1.27x while improving task success rates. At a 50% pruning ratio, it achieves 1.29-1.33x average speedups on both simulation benchmarks, with overall success rates within 1.0 percentage point of the baseline.
tldr: This paper proposes CF-Prune, a training-free pruning framework that accelerates inference in world action models by selectively prunning future-frame tokens based on instruction and action attention, achieving consistent speedups and maintained success rates on simulation and real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CF-Prune，一种免训练的剪枝框架，通过根据指令和动作注意力在预训练世界动作模型中选择性剪枝未来帧标记，从而在仿真和真实操作任务中实现加速并保持成功率。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）联合预测未来视觉状态与机器人动作，但处理密集的未来帧令牌会带来显著的推理延迟。我们提出CF-Prune，一种无需训练的框架，用于剪枝预训练WAMs中的未来帧令牌。我们的关键洞见在于，未来视觉预测服务于动作生成，因此无需保留高保真视频合成所需的全部视觉细节。CF-Prune结合指令注意力与动作注意力，在初始去噪前向传播中识别任务相关令牌，即便未来帧与动作表示仍高度噪声化。一种基于熵的相位识别机制进一步在精度阶段保留密集计算，以缓解剪枝导致的性能退化。在RoboLab、RoboCasa及真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，推理速度持续提升。在35%剪枝率下，CF-Prune实现平均1.19-1.27倍加速，同时提升任务成功率。在50%剪枝率下，其在两个仿真基准上实现平均1.29-1.33倍加速，整体成功率与基线相差在1.0个百分点以内。

title: FOMI: A Force-Feedback Manipulation Interface for Teaching Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Robot-free collection with handheld interfaces enables scalable acquisition of human demonstrations for policy learning. However, existing handheld interfaces often provide limited intuitive force feedback, making contact-rich demonstration collection challenging for human operators. To address this, we present FOMI, a force-feedback manipulation interface with a scissor-shaped mechanism, which transmits object interaction forces directly to the operator's hands through actuation links without force sensors. This intuitive force feedback supports real-time action adjustment during robot-free collection of contact-rich demonstrations. Around FOMI, we build a demonstration collection system that integrates sensor calibration, data acquisition, and synchronization for robot-free collection. By further mapping pose changes and gripper opening of FOMI to robot end-effector poses and gripper commands, the system also supports teleoperation. Across four contact-rich tasks, FOMI improves collection efficiency by approximately 29% and 18% over the best baselines in robot-free collection and teleoperation, respectively. Demonstrations collected with FOMI in both modes enable policies to perform challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks with high success rates.
tldr: FOMI introduces a force-feedback handheld interface with a scissor mechanism for collecting contact-rich manipulation demonstrations without force sensors, improving collection efficiency and enabling successful policy learning in both robot-free and teleoperation modes.
tldr_zh: FOMI 提出了一种带有力反馈的剪刀式手持界面，无需力传感器即可在无机器人演示采集中传递接触力，提高了采集效率并支持策略学习。
summary_zh: 无机器人参与的采集结合手持式接口，能够实现规模化获取用于策略学习的人类演示数据。然而，现有的手持式接口往往提供的直观力反馈有限，使得操作者在进行接触密集型的演示采集时面临挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了FOMI——一种采用剪刀式结构的力反馈操控接口，该接口通过传动连杆将物体交互力直接传递给操作者的双手，无需力传感器。这种直观的力反馈支持在无机器人采集接触密集型演示过程中进行实时动作调整。围绕FOMI，我们构建了一套演示采集系统，集成了传感器校准、数据采集与同步功能，以实现无机器人采集。通过进一步将FOMI的位姿变化和夹爪开合映射到机器人末端执行器的位姿和夹爪指令，该系统还支持遥操作。在四项接触密集型任务中，FOMI在无机器人采集和遥操作模式下，相较于最优基线方法，分别将采集效率提升了约29%和18%。通过FOMI在两种模式下采集的演示数据，能够使策略以高成功率完成具有挑战性的接触密集型操作任务。

title: What Matters for World Modeling in Vision-Language-Action Models?
summary: Integrating world models into Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) has emerged as a promising direction, enabling policies to anticipate future dynamics beyond reactive observation-to-action mapping. However, existing approaches vary simultaneously in their world representations, integration paradigms, and policy backbones, making it difficult to determine what truly matters for effective world model integration. To disentangle these factors, we categorize existing efforts into four representative paradigms, namely Implicit Future Alignment, Explicit Future Query, MoT Future Expert, and External World Predictor. We instantiate each within a unified framework and systematically evaluate these paradigms with diverse world representations and policy backbones across in-domain, out-of-domain, long-horizon, dynamic, few-shot, and real-world settings. Our study yields four main findings: 1) world representation effectiveness is paradigm-dependent, whereas 2D semantic representations offer robust, cross-paradigm gains; 2) no single paradigm is universally optimal, yet the decoupled MoT Future Expert offers competitive overall performance, particularly in OOD robustness; 3) world modeling consistently benefits policies built on standard VLMs, while decoupled designs exhibit greater compatibility with pretrained VLAs; and 4) world modeling improves performance over action-only baselines across multiple settings, with notable gains on long-horizon and dynamic tasks. Project page and video demonstrations are available at https://dylanmqs.github.io/WM-in-VLAs/.
tldr: This paper systematically disentangles the design choices in integrating world models into Vision-Language-Action models by categorizing them into four paradigms and evaluating them across diverse settings, revealing that world representation effectiveness is paradigm-dependent and decoupled designs offer robust gains.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将世界模型集成到视觉-语言-动作模型中的设计选择归纳为四种范式，并在多种设置下进行评估，揭示了世界表示的有效性依赖于范式，且解耦设计提供稳健的提升。
summary_zh: 将世界模型整合至视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）中已成为一个颇具前景的研究方向，使策略能够超越被动的观测-动作映射，对未来动态进行预测。然而，现有方法在世界表征、整合范式及策略主干等方面各有不同，这使确定世界模型整合的关键要素变得困难重重。为厘清这些因素，我们将现有研究划分为四种代表性范式，即隐式未来对齐、显式未来查询、MoT未来专家及外部世界预测器。我们在统一框架内对每种范式进行了实例化，并系统评估了这些范式在不同世界表征和策略主干下，在域内、域外、长时程、动态、少样本及真实世界等多类场景中的表现。本研究得出四项主要结论：1）世界表征的有效性依赖于具体范式，其中二维语义表征能够提供稳健的跨范式增益；2）没有任何单一范式普遍最优，但解耦的MoT未来专家在整体性能上具有竞争力，尤其在域外鲁棒性方面表现突出；3）世界建模对基于标准VLM构建的策略始终有所助益，而解耦设计则与预训练VLA具有更强的兼容性；4）相较仅基于动作的基线，世界建模在多种设置下均能提升性能，在长时程和动态任务中提升尤为显著。项目主页和视频演示参见：https://dylanmqs.github.io/WM-in-VLAs/。

title: Refine Actions If Needed: Adaptive Action Chunk Refinement for Robot Manipulation
summary: Computationally lightweight manipulation policies predict executable actions with low inference latency, but prediction errors can limit task success. Iterative generative policies can achieve higher task success rates, but repeated network evaluations increase inference latency. Refining action proposals from computationally lightweight policies can combine these strengths, but the amount of refinement needed varies across states. We introduce RAIN (Refine Actions If Needed), a framework that predicts action errors at different refinement levels to decide whether and how much to refine each executable proposal, before performing any refinement. We train an ensemble to predict these errors by comparing action proposals and their refined versions with expert actions from offline demonstrations, without requiring explicit labels of refinement needs. Calibration balances uncertainty, computation, and temporal consistency. We evaluate RAIN on eight ManiSkill tasks and four real-robot tasks. In simulation, our policy achieves 66.6% success, approaching the best evaluated diffusion-policy success rate with 5.71 times lower policy latency. On the real robot, success increases from 55.0% with Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) to 72.5%, with comparable average successful completion time. Matched controls show that dynamic routing maintains the strongest observed fixed-refinement success level with 26.6% fewer refiner evaluations. Project page: https://rain-policy.github.io/.
tldr: RAIN adaptively refines action proposals from lightweight policies to achieve high task success with low inference latency, using an ensemble trained on offline demonstrations to predict refinement needs before executing them, validated on ManiSkill and real robots.
tldr_zh: RAIN 通过集成模型根据离线演示预测动作提议的改进需求，在轻量级策略的基础上自适应地决定是否及如何改进动作，从而在保持低推理延迟的同时提高任务成功率，并在 ManiSkill 和真实机器人上得到验证。
summary_zh: 计算轻量级的操作策略能以较低的推理延迟预测可执行动作，但预测误差可能限制任务成功率。迭代生成式策略虽能实现更高的任务成功率，但反复的网络评估会增加推理延迟。对计算轻量级策略生成的动作提议进行细化，可以结合两者的优势，但所需细化程度随状态变化而异。我们提出RAIN（按需细化动作框架），该框架在不同细化层级上预测动作误差，以在实施细化之前决定是否细化以及细化每个可执行提议的程度。我们训练一个集成模型，通过将动作提议及其细化版本与离线演示中的专家动作进行对比来预测这些误差，无需显式的细化需求标注。校准机制在不确定性、计算开销和时间一致性之间实现平衡。我们在八个ManiSkill任务和四个真实机器人任务上评估了RAIN。在仿真中，我们的策略达到66.6%的成功率，接近评估中性能最优的扩散策略成功率，且策略推理延迟降低了5.71倍。在真实机器人上，成功率从基于Transformer的动作分块（ACT）的55.0%提升至72.5%，且平均成功完成时间相当。匹配对照组表明，动态路由以较少的细化器评估次数（减少26.6%）维持了最强固定细化方案所达到的成功水平。项目页面：https://rain-policy.github.io/。

title: Coordi-pi: Coordination-Aware Dual-Hand Action Representation for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but extending them to bimanual dexterous manipulation introduces a high-dimensional and structured action space. Existing bimanual VLA policies commonly concatenate right- and left-side arm--hand actions at each control timestep, leaving cross-hand interactions implicit within a single action vector. We introduce Coordi-$π$, a structured action representation for bimanual dexterous manipulation. Coordi-$π$ represents the right- and left-side arm--hand actions as individual action tokens and organizes them into an interleaved sequence, explicitly exposing the two sides within the action sequence. To explicitly encode hand identity and temporal synchronization in this interleaved representation, a learnable hand-identity embedding distinguishes the two sides, while sequence--control-timestep factorized rotary positional encoding (RoPE) separates sequence position from control timestep, allowing actions at the same control timestep to share a temporal coordinate while retaining distinct sequence positions. Across all five bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks in DexJoCo, Coordi-$π$ achieves state-of-the-art performance under both \textit{rand-obj} and \textit{rand-full}, improving the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ from 31.9\% to 51.3\% and from 18.3\% to 32.3\%, respectively. Coordi-$π$ also consistently outperforms $π_{0.5}$ across four real-world bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks.
tldr: Coordi-π introduces a structured action representation for bimanual dexterous manipulation that explicitly models cross-hand interactions via interleaved action tokens, hand-identity embeddings, and factorized positional encoding, achieving state-of-the-art success rates in simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: Coordi-π 提出了一种用于双手灵巧操作的结构化动作表示，通过交错动作标记、手部身份嵌入和分解位置编码显式建模双手交互，在仿真和真实世界任务中取得了最优成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作中展现出强大潜力，但将其扩展至双臂灵巧操作面临高维且结构化的动作空间挑战。现有双臂VLA策略通常在每个控制时间步拼接左右两侧的手臂-手部动作，导致跨手交互在单一动作向量中隐式表达。我们提出Coordi-$π$，一种面向双臂灵巧操作的结构化动作表示方法。Coordi-$π$将左右两侧的手臂-手部动作分别表示为独立动作标记，并将其组织成交替序列，从而在动作序列中显式呈现两侧信息。为在该交替表示中显式编码手部身份和时间同步性，可学习的手部身份嵌入用于区分两侧，而序列-控制时间步分解旋转位置编码（RoPE）则将序列位置与控制时间步分离，使同一控制时间步的动作共享时间坐标，同时保持不同的序列位置。在DexJoCo的所有五项双臂灵巧操作任务中，Coordi-$π$在\textit{rand-obj}和\textit{rand-full}两种设置下均达到最优性能，平均成功率分别从$π_{0.5}$的31.9\%提升至51.3\%，从18.3\%提升至32.3\%。此外，在四项真实世界双臂灵巧操作任务中，Coordi-$π$同样持续优于$π_{0.5}$。

title: One-shot Human Video-Guided Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have recently achieved remarkable progress by leveraging large-scale robot datasets and foundation models for general-purpose robot manipulation. However, their ability to rapidly adapt to novel manipulation tasks beyond the training distribution remains limited. Existing approaches often require task-specific robot demonstrations and additional training, which are labor- and compute-intensive, limiting the scalability of VLA adaptation to open-world scenarios. To reduce this dependence on target-task robot data, we propose CapPro, a framework that enables a VLA policy to adapt to previously unseen manipulation tasks using only a single human demonstration video. CapPro consists of two components. First, a phase-aware human video representation module constructs a compact video representation through learned visual token selection and learns task-relevant query representations under phase-caption supervision. Second, a video-conditioned adaptation module jointly incorporates the compact video and query-derived representations into the action-conditioning context of the pretrained VLA policy. % This design introduces task-specific guidance while largely preserving the original VLA action-generation backbone. In this way, the human demonstration provides task-specific execution guidance rather than an embodiment-aligned trajectory to imitate, without requiring target-task robot demonstrations or target-task fine-tuning. Experiments across source and unseen target tasks show that CapPro improves average performance across unseen target groups while maintaining comparable performance on the source tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of human-video guidance for cross-task VLA adaptation.
tldr: This paper introduces CapPro, a framework that adapts vision-language-action (VLA) models to new manipulation tasks using only a single human demonstration video, without requiring target-task robot demonstrations or fine-tuning, by learning phase-aware video representations and conditioning the VLA policy's action generation on this task-specific guidance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 CapPro 框架，仅利用单个人类演示视频即可让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适应新的操作任务，无需目标任务的机器人演示或微调，通过学习相位感知的视频表示并将其作为任务特定指导来条件化 VLA 策略的动作生成。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型近年来通过利用大规模机器人数据集和基础模型，在通用机器人操作方面取得了显著进展。然而，其快速适应超出训练分布范围的新颖操作任务的能力仍然有限。现有方法通常需要针对特定任务采集机器人演示数据并进行额外训练，这既耗费人力又计算密集，限制了VLA适应开放世界场景的可扩展性。为减少对目标任务机器人数据的依赖，我们提出了CapPro框架，该框架仅需单个人类演示视频即可使VLA策略适应此前未见过的操作任务。CapPro包含两个组件。第一，一种相位感知的人类视频表示模块，通过习得的视觉标记选择构建紧凑的视频表示，并在相位字幕监督下学习与任务相关的查询表示。第二，一种视频条件适应模块，将紧凑视频和查询派生表示联合融入预训练VLA策略的动作条件上下文中。该设计引入了任务特定引导，同时大幅保留了原有VLA动作生成主干结构。通过这种方式，人类演示提供的并非与实体对齐的可模仿轨迹，而是任务特定的执行引导，无需目标任务的机器人演示或目标任务的微调。在源任务和未见目标任务上的实验表明，CapPro在保持源任务性能相当的同时，提升了未见目标组上的平均性能。这些结果验证了人类视频引导对跨任务VLA适应有效性。

title: Uncertainty-Driven Self-Play for Robust Multi-Agent Driving Policies
summary: Learning robust driving policies that generalize beyond their training domain remains a central challenge in motion planning. We propose an uncertainty-driven self-play scheme, in which half of the agents are rewarded for increasing their neighbors' epistemic uncertainty, while the other half learn to drive safely as the exploring agents continuously seek out their weaknesses. Epistemic uncertainty indicates where the policy is least confident and serves as an automatic proxy for scenario difficulty. Exploring agents use this signal to seek out hard cases, generating a challenging curriculum without manual scenario design. The resulting policy outperforms standard self-play, achieving best-in-class zero-shot transfer to nuplan Val14 (99.12% vs. 97.97%) and Argoverse 2 (82.39% vs. 78.03%) without fine-tuning, while also improving performance over standard self-play on Waymo. Our diversity-driven approach achieves 85% higher LSTM hidden-state coverage than the baseline, indicating a much richer set of behaviors. Further analysis shows that epistemic uncertainty serves as a calibrated difficulty detector, with highest-uncertain agents exhibiting 14.8 times the combined failure rate across collision, off-road, and DNF, of lowest-uncertain agents, enabling automatic prioritization of challenging scenarios without ground-truth labels.
tldr: The paper introduces an uncertainty-driven self-play training scheme for multi-agent driving policies, where exploring agents are rewarded for increasing neighbors' epistemic uncertainty to automatically generate a challenging curriculum. The resulting policy achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot transfer on nuPlan and Argoverse 2, outperforming standard self-play baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种不确定性驱动的自博弈训练方案，用于多智能体驾驶策略，其中探索智能体通过增加邻居的认知不确定性来自动生成具有挑战性的课程。所得策略在nuPlan和Argoverse 2上实现了最先进的零样本迁移，优于标准自博弈基线。
summary_zh: 学习能够超越训练领域泛化的稳健驾驶策略，仍是运动规划中的核心挑战。我们提出了一种基于不确定性的自我对弈机制，其中一半智能体以增加其邻居的认知不确定性为奖励目标，而另一半智能体则学习安全驾驶，同时探索型智能体持续寻找其弱点。认知不确定性指示了策略最不自信的区域，并作为场景难度的自动代理指标。探索型智能体利用这一信号寻找困难案例，从而在无需人工场景设计的情况下生成具有挑战性的课程。最终策略优于标准自我对弈，在无需微调的情况下，实现了对nuplan Val14（99.12%对比97.97%）和Argoverse 2（82.39%对比78.03%）的最佳零样本迁移性能，同时在Waymo上也较标准自我对弈有所提升。我们的多样性驱动方法相比基线实现了85%更高的LSTM隐藏状态覆盖率，表明其产生了丰富得多的行为集合。进一步分析表明，认知不确定性可作为校准的难度检测器，最高不确定性智能体的碰撞、越野和未完成（DNF）综合失败率是最低不确定性智能体的14.8倍，从而能够在无需真实标签的情况下自动优先处理具有挑战性的场景。

title: ACRO: Actor-Critic Rollout Orchestration
summary: Executing a vision-language-action (VLA) policy involves deciding when to continue an attempt and when to intervene to improve its chances of success. We introduce ACRO, an Actor--Critic rollout orchestration layer that makes these decisions for a fixed VLA. ACRO seeks interventions that offer a more promising continuation, are physically feasible, and leave sufficient time to complete the task. A Critic learned from policy rollouts estimates success prospects to decide when to intervene and select a re-entry target along the executed trajectory. Trajectory Retraction shortcuts the visited path to return the robot to that target, where the same VLA resumes execution from a fresh observation. We evaluate ACRO with GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ across SimplerEnv, RoboCasa, and real-robot manipulation. Under the same physical execution budget, including all return motion, ACRO improves success by 10.4, 7.3, and 21.7 percentage points, respectively. It also completes additional tasks as the execution budget grows. These results show that controlling when and where a policy resumes can turn its existing capabilities into more successful task executions. Project page: https://junhoo.me/acro
tldr: ACRO introduces a critic-based rollout orchestration layer that decides when to interrupt and retract a VLA policy execution to a re-entry target, improving success rates across simulated and real manipulation benchmarks under a fixed execution budget.
tldr_zh: ACRO 提出了一种基于评论家的 rollout 编排层，决定何时中断并回退 VLA 策略执行到重新进入的目标点，从而在固定执行预算下提高模拟和真实操控基准的成功率。
summary_zh: 执行视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略涉及决定何时继续当前尝试，以及何时进行干预以提高其成功概率。我们提出ACRO，一种演员-评论家回放编排层，为固定的VLA策略做出这些决策。ACRO寻求的干预应具备更有前景的延续路径、物理可行性，并留有足够的时间完成任务。从策略回放中学习得到的评论家模型估计成功前景，以决定何时干预，并沿已执行轨迹选择重新进入的目标点。轨迹回退会缩短已访问路径，将机器人送回该目标位置，在此处，同一VLA策略从新的观测状态继续执行。我们使用GR00T N1.7和π₀.₅在SimplerEnv、RoboCasa以及真实机器人操作任务中评估ACRO。在相同的物理执行预算下（包括所有回退运动），ACRO的成功率分别提升了10.4、7.3和21.7个百分点。随着执行预算增加，它还能完成更多附加任务。这些结果表明，控制策略恢复执行的时间和位置，可以将其现有能力转化为更成功的任务执行。项目页面：https://junhoo.me/acro

title: F2A-ObjectNav: An Adaptive Agentic Architecture for Object-Goal Navigation
summary: Object-goal navigation requires an embodied agent to explore an unfamiliar environment, identify a target object, navigate toward candidate instances, and reliably determine whether the observed object satisfies the mission goal. This work investigates this problem through a two-stage development process. In Stage I, a fixed modular framework is used to examine combinations of exploration, object detection, and target validation methods. The results reveal clear trade-offs among navigation performance, validation reliability, execution time, and model-related cost, with no single fixed configuration remaining preferable across all evaluated conditions. These observations motivate F2A-ObjectNav (Fixed-to-Adaptive Object-Goal Navigation), an adaptive agentic architecture in which a rule-based Supervisor coordinates specialized components for navigation and exploration, object detection, target validation, semantic guidance, and Mission Memory. The architecture uses event-driven recovery, strategy revision, candidate management, and conditional semantic guidance while retaining lightweight execution during normal operation. F2A-ObjectNav is evaluated over 25 episodes in each of AI2-THOR, RoboTHOR, and ProcTHOR, achieving success rate (SR) / success-weighted path length (SPL) values of 0.84/0.52, 0.40/0.22, and 0.44/0.37, respectively. In addition to task-level metrics, architecture-specific behavioral metrics are used to characterize semantic-guidance usage, strategy switching, recovery activation, memory-supported behavior, and decision stability. The results show different patterns of adaptive intervention across the three environments, with higher intervention frequencies observed in RoboTHOR and ProcTHOR than in AI2-THOR.
tldr: This paper introduces F2A-ObjectNav, an adaptive agentic architecture for object-goal navigation that coordinates a rule-based supervisor with specialized components, achieving strong success rates across multiple embodied environments (AI2-THOR, RoboTHOR, ProcTHOR).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了F2A-ObjectNav，一种用于目标导航的自适应智能体架构，通过规则监督器协调专用组件，在多个具身环境中取得了较高的成功率。
summary_zh: 目标导向导航要求具身智能体在陌生环境中进行探索，识别目标物体，导航至候选实例，并可靠地判断所观察到的物体是否满足任务目标。本研究通过两阶段开发流程对该问题进行探讨。在阶段一中，采用固定的模块化框架，考察探索、物体检测与目标验证方法的组合效果。实验结果表明，导航性能、验证可靠性、执行时间与模型相关成本之间存在明显的权衡关系，在所有评估条件下，没有任何一种固定配置始终占优。这些观察促使我们提出F2A-ObjectNav（固定到自适应目标导向导航）——一种自适应智能体架构，其中基于规则的监督器协调导航与探索、物体检测、目标验证、语义引导和任务记忆等专用组件。该架构采用事件驱动的恢复机制、策略修正、候选管理及条件性语义引导，同时在正常运行期间保持轻量级执行。F2A-ObjectNav在AI2-THOR、RoboTHOR和ProcTHOR中各25个情节上进行评估，分别取得了成功率（SR）/成功率加权路径长度（SPL）为0.84/0.52、0.40/0.22和0.44/0.37的结果。除任务级指标外，还使用架构特定的行为指标来刻画语义引导使用、策略切换、恢复激活、记忆支持行为及决策稳定性。结果表明，三种环境中的自适应干预模式各不相同，RoboTHOR和ProcTHOR中的干预频率高于AI2-THOR。

title: PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation
summary: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust locomotion for legged robots, but learned policies are typically tied to a specific robot morphology and require additional engineering when the number of legs, actuators, or mechanical properties change. We present PolyMorph, a morphology-conditioned framework that learns a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots. PolyMorph converts each robot's URDF into joint-link modules and combines a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to generate actions across variable leg counts and joint configurations. To improve training stability, PolyMorph uses morphology-normalized rewards, adaptive robot sampling, and URDF-derived PD-gain initialization. We evaluate PolyMorph in simulation across bipedal, tripedal, and quadrupedal robots, including unseen morphology variants and platforms, and deploy the policy on real quadruped platforms operated in multiple configurations. The results show that a single PolyMorph policy generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without per-robot policy retraining.
tldr: PolyMorph presents a morphology-conditioned reinforcement learning framework that trains a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots, using a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to handle variable leg counts and joints, successfully deployed on real quadruped platforms.
tldr_zh: PolyMorph 提出了一种基于形态条件的强化学习框架，通过循环编码器、图Transformer和逐关节解码器，训练单一运动策略以适配不同形态的腿式机器人，并在真实四足平台上成功部署。
summary_zh: 强化学习已使腿式机器人实现了稳健的 locomotion，但学习到的策略通常与特定机器人形态绑定，当腿的数量、执行器或机械属性发生变化时，需要额外的工程设计。我们提出了 PolyMorph，一种形态条件化框架，可针对异质腿式机器人学习单一 locomotion 策略。PolyMorph 将每个机器人的 URDF 转换为关节-连杆模块，并结合循环编码器、基于图的 Transformer 和逐关节解码器，在可变腿部数量和关节配置下生成动作。为提高训练稳定性，PolyMorph 采用形态归一化奖励、自适应机器人采样以及从 URDF 推导的 PD 增益初始化。我们在双足、三足和四足机器人的仿真中评估了 PolyMorph，包括未见过的形态变体和平台，并在多种配置下运行的真实四足平台上部署了该策略。结果表明，单一 PolyMorph 策略能泛化到多种机器人形态，而无需针对每个机器人重新训练策略。

title: Cracking Mobile Manipulation: From Failure Diagnosis to Agentic Robot System
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on local robot manipulation, yet their success does not readily translate to long-horizon mobile manipulation. In our experiments, a pretrained subtask VLA achieves 80% success rate on atomic manipulation tasks but only 19% when these skills are composed into mobile manipulation. We argue that this gap stems from failures across the execution process rather than from local manipulation capability alone. To uncover these bottlenecks, we systematically diagnose failures in long-horizon mobile manipulation and identify three dominant regimes: task planning, navigation and base positioning, and local manipulation. Based on this diagnosis, we develop failure-guided agentic intervention that augments a fixed subtask VLA with demonstration-based planning guidance, adaptive visual memory, accessibility-aware base adjustment, and local end-effector adjustment. On RoboCasa365, these interventions progressively improve task success from 19% to 47%, with the finalized system reaching 49% on held-out episode seeds, compared with 18% for the baseline. The same design improves performance from 14% to 37% on BEHAVIOR-1K and from 5/20 to 13/20 on real-robot tasks. These results suggest that reliable mobile manipulation can be advanced by diagnosing and intervening on the current bottleneck, rather than uniformly scaling the underlying policy. Our code will be released at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/Cracking-Mobile-Manipulation.git.
tldr: This paper diagnoses the gap between subtask VLA performance and long-horizon mobile manipulation success, identifying planning, navigation, and local manipulation bottlenecks, and proposes a failure-guided agentic system that significantly improves task success across RoboCasa365, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文诊断了子任务VLA性能与长时程移动操作成功之间的差距，识别出规划、导航和局部操作瓶颈，并提出一种失败引导的智能体系统，在RoboCasa365、BEHAVIOR-1K和真实机器人上显著提高了任务成功率。
