We further demonstrate the platform in two surgical use cases: teleoperation of a continuum camera in a constrained environment and bimanual manipulation using $2.53$~mm concentric-tube-robot-based forceps alongside a conventional wristed instrument. All hardware designs and ROS-based software are open-sourced to facilitate reuse and further research in continuum and surgical robotics.
tldr: This paper presents a unified actuation platform for continuum robots, decoupling hardware and software to enable modular, scalable, and reusable actuation across different robot designs, with validation on surgical systems achieving sub-millimeter accuracy and demonstrating teleoperation and bimanual manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于连续体机器人的统一驱动平台，将驱动硬件和软件与机器人设计解耦，实现了跨不同设计的模块化、可扩展和可复用的驱动，并在手术系统上验证了亚毫米精度以及遥操作和双臂操作。
summary_zh: 连续体机器人在微创手术和工业检测等应用中，能够在受限空间内实现灵巧操作。然而，其驱动系统通常针对特定机器人结构和任务进行定制设计，限制了其在文献、机构及应用之间的复用。本文提出了一种统一的驱动平台，将驱动硬件和软件与连续体机器人设计解耦。该平台提供跨连续体机器人类别的模块化驱动，可扩展至大量自由度，并能与传统串联机械臂集成以构建混合架构。我们在一个开源手术机器人系统上验证了该平台，并对驱动模块进行了实验表征，在30~mm和180°范围内分别实现了亚毫米级平移精度和小于5°的旋转误差。我们还进一步在两种手术使用场景中展示了该平台：在受限环境中对连续体相机进行遥操作，以及使用基于2.53~mm同心管机器人的镊子与常规腕式器械进行双手操作。所有硬件设计和基于ROS的软件均已开源，以促进连续体与手术机器人领域的复用和进一步研究。

title: Eye, Robot: Learning Expressive Gaze Dynamics via a VLM-Guided Transformer-VAE
summary: Gaze coordinates attention in human interaction through coupled eye, head, and eyelid motion. A humanoid robot must choose where to look while generating a suitable movement toward that target; fixed tracking rules alone do not model the temporal structure of human gaze. We separate these tasks with an asynchronous vision-language model that selects a scene referent, a reactive perception module that maintains fixation, and a Realistic Gaze Transformer (RGT) that generates target-conditioned motion. RGT is a Transformer-VAE trained on markerless human recordings retargeted to the robot's 11-DoF joint space: self-supervised pretraining encodes recent full-head history, and autoregressive fine-tuning exposes the model to its own predictions during rollout. At inference, a four-dimensional binocular-eye trajectory conditions coordinated neck and eye motion; an auxiliary blink predictor triggers eyelid templates during playback. On a two-second benchmark in which all controllers receive the same ground-truth target, RGT-Base obtains the lowest reported overall seven-joint MSE, and physical demonstrations show the integrated targeting and control pipeline. The evidence establishes robot-space kinematic fidelity and real-time RGT inference; perceived naturalness and open-vocabulary target-selection accuracy remain questions for controlled evaluation.
tldr: This paper presents a VLM-guided Transformer-VAE (RGT) for generating expressive humanoid gaze dynamics, integrating target selection, fixation, and generation of neck-eye-blink motions, with real-time inference and kinematic fidelity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个由VLM引导的Transformer-VAE（RGT）用于生成逼真的人形机器人注视动态，整合了目标选择、注视保持以及颈-眼-眨眼动作生成，并支持实时推理和运动学保真。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
人类互动中的注视协调依赖于眼睛、头部及眼睑的联合运动。人形机器人必须选择合适的注视目标，同时生成朝向该目标的合适动作；仅依靠固定的追踪规则无法模拟人类注视的时间结构。我们通过一个异步视觉-语言模型选择场景参照物、一个反应式感知模块维持注视锁定，以及一个真实感注视变换器（RGT）生成目标条件化动作，从而将这些任务分离处理。RGT是一种基于Transformer的变分自编码器，在无标记人体动作捕捉数据上训练，并将其重定向至机器人11自由度关节空间：自监督预训练编码近期全头状态历史，自回归微调使模型在推演过程中暴露于自身预测。在推理阶段，一个四维双目眼动轨迹调节颈部与眼部的协同运动；辅助眨眼预测器在播放过程中触发眼睑模板。在两秒基准测试中，所有控制器均接收相同的真值目标，RGT-Base在七个关节整体均方误差上取得最低报告值，物理实验展示了集成式目标选择与控制流程。实验结果验证了机器人空间运动学保真度及RGT的实时推理能力；感知自然度与开放词汇目标选择准确性仍有待受控评估进一步探究。

title: E2DRL: End-to-End Differentiable Reinforcement Learning for 3D Obstacle Avoidance in Quadruped Robots
summary: Differentiable reinforcement learning shows strong promise for robot policy learning, but its application to legged locomotion has remained limited to blind walking or simulated 2D tasks. Extending it to end-to-end visual obstacle avoidance is challenging because hard collision constraints and early termination upon contact corrupt first-order gradients, trapping optimizers in local minima. We present E2DRL, which addresses this with a soft differentiable obstacle-interaction formulation: penetration penalties across multiple body keypoints with velocity-conditioned stop-gradient shaping to provide the first-order training signals for 3D obstacle avoidance. To realize a deployable perception-control system, a privileged teacher trained via Soft Analytic Policy Optimization (SAPO) in a differentiable simulator is distilled into a recurrent depth-based student via DAgger, then blended with a base locomotion policy using a terrain-aware gating module for deployment. In simulation, E2DRL achieves higher sample efficiency than PPO and demonstrates superior velocity-tracking performance and 3D obstacle-avoidance capability compared with both PPO and Duality-based DCBF NMPC. We present the first sim-to-real validation of end-to-end differentiable RL for 3D obstacle avoidance on a Unitree Go2 in static and dynamic environments.
tldr: E2DRL extends differentiable reinforcement learning to end-to-end 3D visual obstacle avoidance for quadruped robots using a soft obstacle-interaction formulation and teacher-student distillation, with sim-to-real deployment on a Unitree Go2.
tldr_zh: E2DRL 通过软障碍交互公式和教师-学生蒸馏，将可微强化学习扩展到四足机器人的端到端 3D 视觉避障，并在 Unitree Go2 上完成了仿真到现实的部署。
summary_zh: 可微强化学习在机器人策略学习方面展现出巨大潜力，但其在腿式运动中的应用仍局限于盲走或仿真2D任务。将其扩展至端到端视觉避障具有挑战性，因为硬碰撞约束和接触时的提前终止会破坏一阶梯度，使优化器陷入局部最优。我们提出E2DRL，通过一种软可微障碍物交互公式应对这一挑战：在多个身体关键点上施加穿透惩罚，并结合基于速度条件的停止梯度整形，为3D避障提供一阶训练信号。为实现可部署的感知-控制系统，在可微仿真器中通过软解析策略优化（SAPO）训练的特权教师模型，经由DAgger方法蒸馏为基于循环神经网络的深度学生模型，随后与基础运动策略通过地形感知门控模块融合以支持实际部署。在仿真中，E2DRL相比PPO展现出更高的样本效率，并且在速度跟踪性能和3D避障能力上均优于PPO和基于对偶的DCBF NMPC方法。我们首次在宇树Go2机器人上完成了端到端可微强化学习用于3D避障的仿真到现实迁移验证，涵盖了静态和动态环境。

title: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control for Robotic Arms: Language-to-Code Decomposition and Reinforcement Learning
summary: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control (ICMC) separates parameter specification, instruction generation, and code synthesis for language-driven robot control, making execution outcomes traceable to instructions and programs. We compare one-shot generation with ICMC under o1 and o4-mini on cube pick-and-place and letter-reshaping tasks for a UR5e arm in MuJoCo. We then train an open-weight instruction policy by GRPO through a frozen code generator on cube placement onto two- and five-cube letter layouts, averaging the rewards of five programs per instruction. The logged positive-reward rate rose from 31.6% to 35.3% (253/800 to 282/800) between the first and last five training steps. A log audit identifies positive binary labels associated with geometric-failure messages: at least 19 in that run, 18 in the dense-reward run, and 5 in the run with one program per instruction. In one case, all five rewards were 1.0 while the log reports a 0.9515 m miss against a 0.05 m tolerance; the verdict came from the program's own output stream. We distinguish logged reward rates from independently verified task success and report descriptive results for each configuration's single training trajectory. We introduce an independent evaluation protocol that checks task completion against fixed specifications, separating robot control from success assessment to support reproducible evaluation.
tldr: This paper introduces Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control (ICMC), which decomposes language-driven robot control into parameter specification, instruction generation, and code synthesis, and evaluates it on a UR5e arm in MuJoCo, showing modest improvements in reward rates via GRPO training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了指令条件运动控制（ICMC），将语言驱动的机器人控制分解为参数规范、指令生成和代码合成，并在MuJoCo中的UR5e机械臂上进行了评估，通过GRPO训练显示出奖励率的适度提升。
summary_zh: 指令条件运动控制（ICMC）将语言驱动的机器人控制中的参数规范、指令生成与代码合成分离，使执行结果可追溯至指令和程序。我们在MuJoCo环境中，针对UR5e机械臂的立方体抓取放置和字母重塑任务，在o1和o4-mini模型下将一次性生成与ICMC进行了比较。随后，我们通过冻结的代码生成器，利用GRPO训练了一个开放权重的指令策略，用于将立方体放置到双立方体和五立方体字母布局上，每条指令取五个程序奖励的平均值。记录的正奖励率在前五个和后五个训练步骤之间从31.6%上升至35.3%（从253/800升至282/800）。日志审计识别出与几何失败消息相关的正二元标签：该次运行中至少有19个，密集奖励运行中有18个，每条指令对应一个程序的运行中有5个。在一个案例中，所有五个奖励均为1.0，而日志报告其相对于0.05米公差存在0.9515米的偏差；该判定结果来自程序自身的输出流。我们将记录的奖励率与独立验证的任务成功率加以区分，并针对每种配置的单一训练轨迹报告描述性结果。我们引入了一种独立评估协议，该协议依据固定规范检查任务完成情况，将机器人控制与成功评估相分离，以支持可复现的评估。

title: ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Force feedback provides vision-language-action (VLA) policies with physical observations that can guide action selection and execution. However, differences in tasks, demonstrations, and control settings across existing systems hinder reliable comparisons of force integration designs. We introduce ForceBench, a simulation benchmark for evaluating six-axis wrist-force integration under a unified protocol. ForceBench combines eight tasks spanning physical-property inference, resistance-dependent interaction, and contact-rich assembly with 1,600 synchronized demonstrations and task-specific success criteria. We compare one no-force baseline and six force integration designs on a shared $π_{0.5}$ backbone. Prompt Fusion achieves the highest observed mean simulation success of 35.31%, compared with 23.25% for the baseline, and improves success rates across all three task categories. Predictive and temporal gains in simulation concentrate on physical-property inference, while both temporal designs underperform the baseline on assembly. Real-world evaluation of eight systems across five tasks supports the main qualitative trends: Prompt Fusion and Dual-Path Fusion achieve 63.00% mean success, compared with 40.00% for the baseline, but only Prompt Fusion improves every task. These findings support ForceBench's practical value for identifying the benefits and limitations of force integration across manipulation demands. The project page is available at https://forcebench-platform.github.io/.
tldr: ForceBench introduces a unified simulation benchmark for evaluating six-axis wrist-force integration designs in robotic manipulation VLA policies, demonstrating that Prompt Fusion improves task success over a no-force baseline in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: ForceBench 引入了一个统一的模拟基准，用于评估机器人操作 VLA 策略中的六轴腕力集成设计，并证明了 Prompt Fusion 在模拟和真实世界实验中均能比无力基线提高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 力反馈为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供物理观测信息，可指导动作选择与执行。然而，现有系统在任务、示范数据和控制设置上的差异，阻碍了对力集成设计进行可靠比较。我们提出了ForceBench，一个在统一协议下评估六轴腕部力集成的仿真基准。ForceBench整合了八个任务，涵盖物理属性推理、阻力相关交互和密集接触装配，并包含1，600个同步示范和任务特定的成功判定标准。我们在共享的$π_{0.5}$骨干网络上比较了一个无力基线和六个力集成设计方案。提示融合（Prompt Fusion）在仿真中实现了最高的平均成功率35.31%，而基线为23.25%，并在全部三个任务类别中均提升了成功率。仿真中的预测性和时序性增益主要集中在物理属性推理任务上，而两种时序设计在装配任务上均低于基线表现。对五个任务上八个系统的真实世界评估支持了主要定性趋势：提示融合和双路径融合（Dual-Path Fusion）实现了63.00%的平均成功率，而基线为40.00%，但仅提示融合在每项任务上均有提升。这些发现验证了ForceBench在识别不同操作需求下力集成的优势与局限方面的实用价值。项目页面见 https://forcebench-platform.github.io/。

title: GS-PRM: Gaussian Visual Roadmap for Image-Goal Navigation
summary: Image-goal navigation requires a global planner that connects visually specified endpoints while providing observations that a local policy can follow. Three-dimensional Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides map-registered RGB, opacity, and depth renderings, but does not explicitly encode navigable topology. We introduce GS-PRM, a Gaussian visual roadmap whose milestones, local connections, and visual references are constructed directly through 3DGS rendering without deriving an occupancy grid or signed distance field. We define render-based collision-free (RC-free) configurations and paths. Panoramic depth supplies conservative clearance for milestone validation and adaptive coverage, while edge-aligned orthographic rendering tests the robot's swept volume. We establish conditional soundness and sufficient conditions for deterministic query completeness and probabilistic construction completeness of GS-PRM. To validate the performance of GS-PRM, we conduct experiments in both simulated and real-world environments, demonstrating long-horizon navigation using goal-conditioned policies guided by GS-PRM. Compared with a state-of-the-art 3DGS-based navigation system, our GS-PRM-based navigation system achieves up to a twice higher average success rate and reduces travel time by up to 57.2% when both systems complete the navigation task.
tldr: GS-PRM constructs a Gaussian visual roadmap directly from 3D Gaussian Splatting renderings to enable global path planning for image-goal navigation in simulated and real environments, without needing an explicit occupancy grid or signed distance field.
tldr_zh: GS-PRM 直接利用三维高斯泼溅的渲染结果构建视觉路标图，无需占用网格或符号距离场，即可在仿真和真实环境中实现图像目标导航的全局路径规划。
summary_zh: 图像目标导航需要一个全局规划器，该规划器能够连接视觉指定的端点，同时提供局部策略可遵循的观测信息。三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）提供了与地图配准的RGB、不透明度和深度渲染，但并未显式编码可导航的拓扑结构。我们提出了GS-PRM，一种高斯视觉路标图，其里程碑节点、局部连接和视觉参考直接通过3DGS渲染构建，无需推导占据网格或符号距离场。我们定义了基于渲染的无碰撞（RC-free）构型和路径。全景深度为里程碑验证和自适应覆盖提供保守间隙，而边缘对齐的正交渲染则测试机器人的扫掠体积。我们建立了GS-PRM的确定性查询完备性和概率性构建完备性的条件可靠性与充分条件。为验证GS-PRM的性能，我们在仿真和真实环境中进行了实验，展示了使用由GS-PRM引导的目标条件策略进行的长时程导航。与最先进的基于3DGS的导航系统相比，在两者均完成导航任务的情况下，我们基于GS-PRM的导航系统的平均成功率最高提升至两倍，旅行时间最多减少57.2%。

title: Dual-arm Cooperation for Tabletop Wiping with Temporal Object Removal
summary: We devise a dual-arm cooperative planning framework for wiping table surface in the presence of scattered objects. Unlike conventional surface-cleaning strategies that only cover free areas and detour around obstacles, our framework explicitly assigns one arm to rearrange objects while the other performs coverage wiping, thereby enabling access to previously obstructed regions. Specifically, we first construct a set of wiping and object-rearrangement action primitives. Based on these primitives, we introduce Geo-MILP, a geometry-aware task planner formulated as Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP). By integrating Logic-Based Benders Decomposition (LBBD), Geo-MILP iteratively optimizes action sequencingand timing to resolve geometric conflicts, promoting efficient cooperation between wiping and object rearrangement. We then employ K-Order Markov Optimization (KOMO) to generate smooth, collision-free motions to ensure feasible execution. Simulation and physical experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework not only increases reachable coverage by enabling access to obstructed areas, but also significantly improves time efficiency compared to Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) baselines, reducing planning time by up to 9 times and execution makespan by approximately 40%.
tldr: This paper presents a dual-arm cooperative planning framework for tabletop wiping that uses one arm to rearrange obstructing objects while the other performs coverage wiping, framed as a geometry-aware MILP with Logic-Based Benders Decomposition. Experiments show improved reachable coverage and significant reductions in planning time and execution makespan over TAMP baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种双臂协作桌面擦拭规划框架，一只手臂整理障碍物，另一只执行覆盖擦拭，通过几何感知的混合整数线性规划（MILP）与逻辑Benders分解优化动作序列与时机，在仿真和实体实验中显著提升可达覆盖率、减少规划时间与执行时长。
summary_zh: 我们设计了一种双臂协同规划框架，用于在存在散落物体的桌面上进行擦拭操作。与传统的仅覆盖自由区域并绕开障碍物的表面清洁策略不同，我们的框架明确地分配一只手臂进行物体重排，另一只手臂执行覆盖式擦拭，从而能够进入先前被遮挡的区域。具体而言，我们首先构建了一组擦拭和物体重排动作原语。基于这些原语，我们引入了Geo-MILP，一种基于几何感知的任务规划器，其形式化为混合整数线性规划（MILP）。通过集成基于逻辑的Benders分解（LBBD），Geo-MILP迭代优化动作序列和时序，以解决几何冲突，促进擦拭与物体重排之间的高效协作。随后，我们采用K阶马尔可夫优化（KOMO）生成平滑且无碰撞的运动，以确保执行可行性。仿真和物理实验表明，所提出的框架不仅通过进入被遮挡区域提高了可达覆盖率，而且相比任务与运动规划（TAMP）基线显著提升了时间效率，规划时间最多减少9倍，执行完成时间减少约40%。

title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
summary: Simulated environments enable scalable training data generation for embodied agents, but more data does not necessarily provide what a particular agent needs to learn. Existing environment-generation pipelines largely optimize generic properties such as realism, diversity, or task coverage, while different pretrained policies can fail for different environmental reasons. We therefore introduce WEDGE, a framework for weakness-guided navigation learning in which the failure modes of a pretrained agent guide the generation of training environments at each adaptation round. Given a pretrained policy, WEDGE uses an LLM to propose executable weakness features from contrasting successful and failed rollouts, automatically validates them on the diagnostic set, and selects the strongest validated weakness based on its success-rate gap. The validated weaknesses are then mapped to the environmental factors that control them. WEDGE varies these factors to construct environments in the difficulty regimes where the policy struggles, producing targeted training experience for adaptation. Across three navigation agents with different adaptation mechanisms, we find that policies exhibit distinct weakness profiles and benefit from different training environments. Weakness-conditioned adaptation consistently outperforms matched random and hard-example alternatives on ProcTHOR, while the resulting gains for Uni-NaVid and Gemini also extend to HM3D after ProcTHOR adaptation. Iterative re-diagnosis further shows that dominant weaknesses can persist or shift as the policy improves, providing updated guidance for subsequent environment construction. Together, these results show that policy failures are not only diagnostic signals, but actionable guidance for constructing training environments that target a policy's current weaknesses.
tldr: This paper introduces WEDGE, a framework that uses LLM-proposed and validated policy weaknesses to generate targeted training environments for navigation agents, demonstrating consistent improvements over random and hard-example baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了WEDGE框架，利用由LLM提出并验证的策略弱点来生成针对性的导航训练环境，并在多个导航智能体上展示了优于随机和困难样本基线的效果。
summary_zh: 模拟环境能够为具身智能体生成可扩展的训练数据，但更多的数据并不一定能为特定智能体提供其所需的学习内容。现有的环境生成流程大多优化通用属性，如真实性、多样性和任务覆盖率，而不同的预训练策略可能因不同的环境原因而失败。为此，我们提出了WEDGE——一种基于弱点的导航学习框架，在该框架中，预训练智能体的失败模式引导每一轮适应训练中训练环境的生成。给定预训练策略后，WEDGE利用大型语言模型从成功与失败轨迹的对比中提出可执行的弱点特征，在诊断集上自动验证这些特征，并根据成功率差距选择验证通过的最强弱点。随后，已验证的弱点被映射到控制这些弱点的环境因素上。WEDGE变化这些因素，在策略表现困难的难度区间构建环境，从而为适应训练提供有针对性的训练经验。在三种具有不同适应机制的导航智能体上，我们发现策略表现出不同的弱点特征，并且受益于不同的训练环境。基于弱点的条件适应在ProcTHOR上始终优于匹配的随机环境和困难样本替代方案，而Uni-NaVid和Gemini在ProcTHOR适应后的收益也延伸至HM3D。迭代再诊断进一步表明，随着策略的改进，主导弱点可能持续存在或发生转移，从而为后续环境构建提供更新的指导。综合来看，这些结果证明策略失败不仅是诊断信号，更是构建针对当前弱点训练环境的可操作指导。

title: NavAble: A Large-Scale Dataset and Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline for Blind Navigation
summary: Reliable recognition of accessibility-critical objects (e.g., audible pedestrian signals, door-activation buttons, and handrails) is essential for assistive navigation technologies that support safe, independent mobility for blind and low-vision (BLV) users. Yet these categories are underrepresented in existing large-scale vision datasets, and the few datasets that include them suffer from limited class coverage, inconsistent annotations, and poor diversity. We introduce NavAble, a large-scale dataset spanning 11 accessibility-critical object classes, combining 41K curated open-source images with 8K newly collected, densely annotated real-world images. To extend scale and diversity, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline that renders high-fidelity 3D assets across 37 environments under diverse styles and viewpoints, yielding 452K frames with rich ground-truth annotations from 565 assets. The pipeline minimizes manual effort by combining automated web image crawling, VLM-based filtering, SAM 3D-based asset generation, and convenient camera trajectory configuration, enabling large-scale data generation at a diversity unattainable through manual collection. Experiments show that fine-tuning existing segmentation models on the NavAble Dataset achieves reliable accessibility-object segmentation (>80% mIoU on our held-out test set). We also demonstrate the effectiveness of synthetic data augmentation, which yields up to +3.5 mIoU over real-world-only fine-tuning. Beyond benchmark evaluation, validation on egocentric data from two mobility-assistive robots demonstrates improved perception reliability in real-world navigation scenarios. Together, NavAble establishes a scalable foundation for BLV navigation perception, directly addressing the data scarcity and embodiment gaps. The dataset and pipeline are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/NavAble/NeurIPS_2026_BLV.
tldr: NavAble introduces a large-scale dataset and synthetic data generation pipeline for accessibility-critical object segmentation, and shows improved perception reliability for assistive navigation robots for blind users.
tldr_zh: NavAble 提出了一个大规模数据集和合成数据生成流程，用于无障碍关键物体的分割，并在助盲导航机器人上验证了感知可靠性的提升。
summary_zh: 对无障碍关键物体（如可听行人信号、门禁按钮和扶手）的可靠识别，对于支持盲人与低视力（BLV）用户安全独立出行的辅助导航技术至关重要。然而，这些类别在现有的大规模视觉数据集中代表性不足，且少数包含这些类别的数据集存在类别覆盖有限、标注不一致和多样性不足等问题。我们提出NavAble，一个涵盖11类无障碍关键物体的大规模数据集，融合了4.1万张精选开源图像与8千张新采集的、密集标注的真实世界图像。为进一步扩展规模与多样性，我们开发了一条合成数据生成流程，利用高保真3D资产在37种环境中以多样化风格和视角进行渲染，从565个资产中生成45.2万帧带有丰富真值标注的图像。该流程通过结合自动化网络图像抓取、基于VLM的过滤、基于SAM 3D的资产生成以及便捷的相机轨迹配置，最大限度减少了人工投入，实现了人工采集无法企及的规模化多样性数据生成。实验表明，在NavAble数据集上微调现有分割模型，可实现可靠的无障碍物体分割（在预留测试集上mIoU超过80%）。我们还证明了合成数据增强的有效性，相较于仅使用真实数据微调，mIoU最高提升3.5个百分点。除基准评估外，在来自两款移动辅助机器人的第一视角数据上的验证表明，真实导航场景中的感知可靠性得到显著提升。综上，NavAble为BLV导航感知建立了可扩展的基础，直接回应了数据稀缺与实体化差距问题。数据集和代码流程已在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/NavAble/NeurIPS_2026_BLV 公开提供。

title: Learning Keypoint Constraints from Visual Demonstrations for Safe Motion Planning
summary: We present Keypoint Constraint Learning (KCL), a framework for learning task-relevant motion constraints from visual demonstrations and for planning safely with the extracted constraints. To make constraint learning tractable from RGB-D observations, we represent demonstrations using sparse 3D object-centric keypoints and semantic mask centroids extracted through segmentation, visual feature clustering, and point tracking. In this reduced geometric space, we learn keypoint dynamics and infer distance- and orientation-based constraints that make the expert trajectories feasible and approximately locally optimal by enforcing KKT optimality conditions in the reduced state space. We then plan with the learned constraints under uncertainty, using robustness margins derived from accumulated prediction error, and provide a theoretical analysis of how keypoint perception error and learned dynamics error affect the recovered constraints. We evaluate KCL on visual demonstrations from navigation to rigid/deformable manipulation, showing that it recovers multi-stage geometric constraints and outperforms baselines in downstream safe planning.
tldr: This paper introduces Keypoint Constraint Learning (KCL), a framework that extracts task-relevant geometric constraints from visual demonstrations using 3D keypoints and semantic masks, and uses them for safe motion planning in navigation and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出关键点约束学习（KCL）框架，利用3D关键点和语义掩码从视觉演示中提取任务相关的几何约束，并将其用于导航和操作任务中的安全运动规划。
summary_zh: 我们提出了关键点约束学习（KCL）框架，该框架从视觉演示中学习与任务相关的运动约束，并利用提取的约束进行安全规划。为使约束学习在RGB-D观测下易于处理，我们通过分割、视觉特征聚类和点跟踪提取稀疏的三维物体中心关键点及语义掩膜质心，以此表示演示。在该降维几何空间中，我们学习关键点动力学，并通过在降维状态空间中强制执行KKT最优性条件，推断基于距离和朝向的约束，使专家轨迹可行且近似局部最优。随后，我们利用累积预测误差推导出的鲁棒性裕度，在不确定性下使用学习到的约束进行规划，并从理论上分析关键点感知误差和学习动力学误差对恢复约束的影响。我们在从导航到刚体/可变形物体操作的视觉演示上评估了KCL，结果表明其能够恢复多阶段几何约束，并在下游安全规划中优于基线方法。

title: DiffGIPC: Differentiable Mixed-Coordinate Contact Dynamics on GPU
summary: Contact-rich inverse problems require efficient gradients and reliable enforcement of non-penetration. Existing differentiable methods provide fast simulation and rigid-deformable coupling, but contact treatments based on penalties or velocity-level constraints can permit penetration or positional drift. Incremental Potential Contact (IPC) maintains non-penetration through geometric barriers and {continuous collision detection (CCD)}. However, repeated forward and backward evaluations remain costly in full-space finite-element (FEM) implementations, particularly when nearly rigid components retain many vertex {degrees of freedom (DoFs)}. We present DiffGIPC, a GPU-accelerated differentiable IPC framework for optimizing interacting deformable and nearly rigid bodies. Our affine-body derivatives enable {rest-shape} design, initial-state optimization, and articulated control while retaining only twelve motion DoFs per affine body. These gradients account for how changes in geometry, placement, and actuation affect other objects through collision and friction. We preserve these interactions in one coupled FEM-affine adjoint system per frame, reducing the backward-system size without discarding the dependencies that drive the inverse problem. GPU-optimized backward computation further reduces the cost of repeated gradient evaluations. A reusable PyTorch interface connects supported physical parameters to user-defined parameter maps and losses across design, identification, motion, placement, and articulated control. Experiments demonstrate peak speedups over DiffIPC of approximately 150.0x with full-space FEM and 4133.3x with affine bodies for combined forward simulation and backward differentiation.
tldr: DiffGIPC is a GPU-accelerated differentiable Incremental Potential Contact framework for optimizing deformable and nearly rigid bodies, using affine-body derivatives and coupled FEM-affine adjoint systems to achieve large speedups in forward simulation and backward differentiation.
tldr_zh: DiffGIPC 是一个基于 GPU 加速的可微分增量势接触框架，用于优化可变形和近似刚体的交互，通过仿射体导数和耦合的 FEM-仿射伴随系统，在前向模拟和反向微分中实现了大幅加速。
summary_zh: 接触丰富型逆问题需要高效的梯度和可靠的不可穿透性约束。现有的可微分方法提供了快速仿真和刚-柔耦合能力，但基于罚函数或速度级约束的接触处理可能允许穿透或产生位置漂移。增量势接触（IPC）通过几何势垒和连续碰撞检测（CCD）保持不可穿透性。然而，在全空间有限元（FEM）实现中，重复的前向和反向求值仍然代价高昂，尤其是当近刚性部件保留大量顶点自由度（DoFs）时。我们提出了DiffGIPC，一个GPU加速的可微分IPC框架，用于优化相互作用的变形体和近刚性体。我们的仿射体导数支持形状设计、初始状态优化和关节控制，同时每个仿射体仅保留十二个运动自由度。这些梯度考虑了几何、位置和驱动变化如何通过碰撞和摩擦影响其他物体。我们在每一帧中将这些相互作用保留在一个耦合的FEM-仿射伴随系统中，从而在不丢弃驱动逆问题的依赖关系的前提下缩小反向系统的规模。GPU优化的反向计算进一步降低了重复梯度评估的成本。一个可复用的PyTorch接口将支持的物理参数连接到用户自定义的参数映射和损失函数，涵盖设计、识别、运动、放置和关节控制。实验表明，与DiffIPC相比，结合前向仿真和反向微分的全空间FEM实现了约150.0倍的峰值加速，而仿射体则实现了约4133.3倍的峰值加速。

title: Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View Planning for Highly Occluded Target Perception
summary: Robotic systems that must acquire information about a specific target often face severe occlusion from sur- rounding structures or from the target itself, such that a single camera viewpoint provides only partial information. Active perception must therefore select viewpoints that progressively reveal unobserved regions. However, conventional local next- best-view (NBV) methods typically select viewpoints according to their immediate utility, which can overlook views that provide limited information initially but enable more informative obser- vations from subsequent viewpoints. We formulated local target perception as a short-horizon sequential view-planning problem and proposed a Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View (RH-NBV) planner that evaluates candidate sequences of future viewpoints rather than isolated views. RH-NBV is evaluated on a UR5e manipulator with an eye-in-hand RGB-D camera in simulation as well as on physical robot against a gradient-based NBV planner, and random search, using a coffee mug and Stanford bunny under controlled occlusion and a tomato plant with natural self-occlusion. Under heavy occlusion, RH-NBV achieves substantially higher target information recovery, reaching 63.8% ROI coverage versus 34.2% and 85.5% occluded-surface recall versus 7.4% for the single-step NBV baselines on the most occluded mug configuration. A controlled horizon ablation shows that this improvement arises from multi-step reasoning rather than additional computation. RH-NBV provides the greatest benefit for strongly occluded targets, while myopic NBV remains competitive and substantially cheaper when visibility is less constrained.
tldr: This paper introduces a receding-horizon next-best-view (RH-NBV) planner that evaluates sequences of future viewpoints for active target perception under severe occlusion, demonstrating on a UR5e manipulator that multi-step reasoning substantially improves information recovery over myopic single-step baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种滚动时域的下一个最佳视角（RH-NBV）规划器，通过评估未来视角序列来应对严重遮挡下的主动目标感知，并在UR5e机械臂上证明多步推理相比单步贪心基线能显著提高信息恢复。
summary_zh: 摘要：需要获取特定目标信息的机器人系统往往面临来自周围结构或目标自身的严重遮挡，导致单一相机视角仅能提供部分信息。因此，主动感知必须选择能够逐步揭示未观测区域的视角。然而，传统的局部“下一最佳视角”（NBV）方法通常根据视角的即时效用进行选择，这可能会忽略那些初始信息有限但能为后续视角提供更丰富观测的视角。本文将局部目标感知建模为一个短时域序贯视角规划问题，并提出了一种滚动时域下一最佳视角（RH-NBV）规划器，该规划器评估未来视角的候选序列而非孤立视角。RH-NBV在配备眼在手式RGB-D相机的UR5e机械臂上进行了仿真评估，并在物理机器人上分别与基于梯度的NBV规划器及随机搜索进行了对比实验，测试对象包括在受控遮挡条件下的咖啡杯和斯坦福兔子，以及具有自然自遮挡的番茄植株。在重度遮挡下，RH-NBV实现了显著更高的目标信息恢复率，在最严重遮挡的杯子配置中，其ROI覆盖率达到63.8%，而单步NBV基线仅为34.2%；遮挡表面召回率达到85.5%，而单步NBV基线仅为7.4%。受控的时域消融实验表明，这一提升源于多步推理而非额外计算。RH-NBV对强遮挡目标效果最为显著，而在可见性约束较小时，短视NBV仍具竞争力且计算成本显著更低。

title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
summary: A multiplayer world model must predict how the independent actions of several players change a shared environment, including changes outside a player's current field of view. A point-of-view (POV) video captures such changes only after they enter its field of view, whereas panoramic video records the surroundings in every viewing direction and has served as an intermediate representation of the world state in recent world models. Learning this task therefore requires synchronized POV and panoramic videos of interacting players together with their actions, yet no existing dataset provides this combination in Minecraft, an established testbed in which players act independently in a shared, modifiable 3D world. We present PAWA, a dataset and framework for action-conditioned panoramic multiplayer world modeling. The dataset pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramic video and aligned actions. Its distributed pipeline decouples CPU gameplay capture from GPU rendering, scales beyond 64 simultaneous players, and re-renders each recorded session under new observation configurations without replaying the gameplay. On this dataset, we develop a dual-tower model that jointly predicts POV and panoramic video and couples the two streams through cross-attention that aligns tokens observing the same direction in a shared world frame. We further introduce a quadratic-phase player encoding that provides many more player codes than existing rotary codes at the same embedding dimension. Experiments show that PAWA outperforms state-of-the-art multiplayer world models in POV prediction quality while also producing high-fidelity panoramic predictions. The dataset and collection pipeline are open source to support further research on multiplayer world models.
tldr: PAWA presents a dataset and dual-tower framework for action-conditioned panoramic world modeling in Minecraft, predicting both POV and panoramic video for multiple interacting agents with cross-attention coupling and a novel quadratic-phase player encoding.
tldr_zh: PAWA 提出了一个多智能体全景动作条件世界建模的数据集和双塔框架，在Minecraft中联合预测第一人称和全景视频，并通过交叉注意力和二次相位编码提升性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：多人世界模型必须预测多个玩家的独立行为如何改变共享环境，包括玩家当前视野之外的变化。视点（POV）视频仅在变化进入视野后捕捉这些变化，而全景视频则记录所有观看方向的环境，并在近年来的世界模型中作为世界状态的中间表示。学习这一任务需要交互玩家的同步POV和全景视频及其动作，但现有数据集中尚无在Minecraft中提供此组合的，Minecraft是一个成熟的测试平台，玩家可在其中共享、可修改的3D世界中独立行动。我们提出PAWA，一个用于动作条件全景多人世界建模的数据集和框架。该数据集将每位玩家的POV视频与世界稳定的全景视频及对齐的动作配对。其分布式流水线将CPU游戏捕获与GPU渲染分离，可扩展至64名以上同时在线玩家，并在新的观察配置下重新渲染每次录制的会话，而无需重放游戏过程。在此数据集上，我们开发了一种双塔模型，联合预测POV和全景视频，并通过交叉注意力将两流耦合，该注意力对齐共享世界框架中观察同一方向的标记。我们进一步引入了一种二次相位玩家编码，在相同嵌入维度下提供比现有旋转码更多的玩家编码。实验表明，PAWA在POV预测质量上优于最先进的多人世界模型，同时产生高保真的全景预测。数据集和采集流水线开源，以支持多人世界模型的进一步研究。

title: Neurosymbolic Learning of Interpretable World Models
summary: World models aim to learn compact representations of an environment from observations, enabling agents to predict future states and plan their behaviour. However, most existing approaches learn black-box representations, with limited ability to incorporate prior knowledge about the world. We introduce Concept-Grounded World Models (CGWMs), a neurosymbolic world model design that instead learns interpretable concept representations. We learn these concepts from observations using explicit and complete knowledge, expressed in temporal logic, that specifies the valid world states and the temporal relations governing their dynamics. Furthermore, we directly use this knowledge by formulating planning as differentiable reasoning, optimising the agent's actions by gradient ascent to satisfy a goal. We experimentally compare CGWM with a purely neural baseline and a neurosymbolic baseline on two game environments. We find that CGWMs ground concepts much more accurately, even over long horizons, resulting in significantly more robust planning both in and out of distribution.
tldr: This paper introduces Concept-Grounded World Models (CGWMs), a neurosymbolic approach that learns interpretable concept representations from observations using temporal logic and enables planning via differentiable reasoning, showing improved grounding and robust planning over purely neural baselines in game environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了概念接地世界模型（CGWM），一种神经符号方法，利用时序逻辑从观测中学习可解释的概念表示，并通过可微推理进行规划，在游戏环境中展示了比纯神经基线更准确的接地和更稳健的规划。
summary_zh: 世界模型旨在从观测中学习环境的紧凑表征，使智能体能够预测未来状态并规划其行为。然而，大多数现有方法学习的是黑箱表征，难以融入关于世界的先验知识。我们引入了概念 grounded 世界模型（CGWMs），这是一种神经符号世界模型设计，转而学习可解释的概念表征。我们利用以时序逻辑表达的显式且完整的知识，从观测中学习这些概念，这些知识规定了有效的世界状态及其动态变化所遵循的时序关系。此外，我们直接利用这些知识，将规划形式化为可微推理，通过梯度上升优化智能体的动作以满足目标。我们在两个游戏环境中，将CGWM与纯神经基线及神经符号基线进行了实验对比。结果发现，CGWMs 能更准确地落地概念，即使在长时间跨度下也是如此，从而在分布内和分布外场景中均实现了显著更稳健的规划。

title: StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning
summary: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities' changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft, a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. We evaluate our approach on generative interfaces, which pose a substantial challenge because a single action may change parts of the state that are not currently visible. To support training and evaluation, we develop a data collection pipeline that produces informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale without human or agent supervision, together with a benchmark measuring generation quality, memory, and controllability. On this benchmark, our approach improves surpasses the state-of-the-art baselines. We demonstrate that StateCraft maintains high self-consistency and strong generation quality over long trajectories. Because the abstract state is explicit, it can be edited directly, and generation follows edits to states never observed in the data. Finally, a proof-of-concept 3D experiment, in which actions change the illumination of an unobserved room, shows that the paradigm can also be applied to spatial environments. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/.
tldr: StateCraft augments video world models with a persistent, updatable abstract state tracked by a language model, conditioning the visual diffusion state to improve long-horizon consistency and controllability in generative interfaces and spatial environments.
tldr_zh: StateCraft 通过语言模型跟踪可更新的抽象状态，并将其条件化到视频扩散模型的视觉状态，从而提升生成式界面和空间环境中长程生成的连贯性与可控性。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型旨在模拟具有逼真外观和动态特性的复杂环境。要在长时间交互中保持一致性，需要追踪过往动作并理解这些动作对环境产生的影响。视频世界模型每次只能生成整个世界的部分观测结果。仅凭记忆过去的观测信息在某些场景下可能不够充分，因为这些观测在经历一系列动作后可能已无法反映当前的世界状态。我们提出了一种将持久化、可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦的范式。抽象状态在世界演化过程中持续追踪实体的变化，并用于条件化当前视图所对应的视觉状态。我们提出了StateCraft，这是一种新颖的架构，将语言模型与视频扩散模型配对，以演化动态世界。我们在生成式接口上评估了我们的方法，这类接口构成了重大挑战，因为单个动作可能会改变当前不可见部分的状态。为支持训练与评估，我们开发了一套数据采集流水线，能够在无需人工或智能体监督的情况下，大规模生成信息丰富、密集标注的轨迹数据，同时构建了一个用于衡量生成质量、记忆能力和可控性的基准测试。在该基准上，我们的方法超越了现有的最先进基线。我们证明StateCraft在长轨迹上保持了高度的自一致性以及出色的生成质量。由于抽象状态是显式的，因此可以直接对其进行编辑，生成过程会遵循对数据中从未观测过的状态的编辑。最后，一项概念验证性的3D实验——其中动作改变了未观测房间的照明——表明该范式同样适用于空间环境。项目页面：https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/。

title: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
summary: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.
tldr: Glance Forcing introduces a highly efficient distillation method for converting bidirectional diffusion models into causal few-step generators for video world models, decoupling the denoising trajectory into slow and fast experts and using a single PF-ODE trajectory to surpass prior baselines with drastically reduced computational cost.
tldr_zh: Glance Forcing 提出了一种高效的蒸馏方法，将双向扩散模型转换为用于视频世界模型的因果少步生成器，通过将去噪轨迹分解为快慢专家，并使用单个 PF-ODE 轨迹，在显著降低计算成本的同时超越了现有基线。
summary_zh: 自回归生成支撑着实时、因果视频合成，是视频世界模型的基石。当前主流方法将双向扩散模型蒸馏为因果少步学生模型，但现有流程使这一转换代价极其高昂，需要离线生成概率流常微分方程（PF-ODE）轨迹，耗费数万GPU小时和TB级存储。我们证明这一过程可以大幅提效。将效率推至极致，我们把轨迹监督缩减为单个样本——这是最严格的设定——却发现这会导致严重的质量坍塌。我们将其归因于教师模型的轨迹几何特性：控制语义布局与运动的高噪声区域，与控制精细纹理的低噪声区域，展现出根本不同的曲率与优化行为，因此单一的整体学生模型无法同时拟合两者，造成严重的表征干扰。基于此，我们提出Glance Forcing——一个轻量级蒸馏框架，将去噪轨迹解耦为互补的慢速与快速两个专家模型，每个由针对性的阶段特定目标引导，同时保持预训练教师模型完全冻结。这一解耦进一步揭示了少步蒸馏背后的通用机制：PF-ODE蒸馏主要拉直少步轨迹的几何结构，而随后的分布匹配阶段独立决定分布质量。仅使用一条PF-ODE轨迹，Glance Forcing便超越了完全训练的最先进基线，将VBench总分从84.04提升至84.22，同时将轨迹采集成本从数千GPU小时降至约1个A100-GPU小时，在动态程度、VisionReward和指令跟随方面取得显著更大增益，且人类评估者对强基线的偏好保持一致。

title: OneLA: Learning Many Worlds from Latent Actions
summary: Learning world models across diverse domains calls for a unified control space, yet ac- tion interfaces vary across domains and action annotations are often scarce. Latent ac- tions learned directly from videos offer a promising way to establish such a space without explicit action supervision. However, learning shared latent actions across domains re- mains challenging, as variations in appearance, embodiment, and dynamics can entangle domain-specific visual cues with transferable transition structure. To this end, we intro- duce OneLA, a simple framework that learns continuous latent actions through a shared orthogonal dictionary and a common predictive objective, without task-specific designs or cross-domain alignment losses during latent action pretraining. These latent actions pro- vide a shared conditioning interface for world models, with lightweight adapters mapping native control commands into the same space. Conditioned on latent actions and the cur- rent visual state, the world model predicts context-dependent transitions for controllable rollout. OneLA improves action readout across domains and reduces action cycle-transfer rotation error by 24.8% over the strongest evaluated baseline. A joint-training comparison further shows a 20.5% improvement in Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) for real- scene generation. These results suggest a path toward general-purpose world models that learn from diverse videos and support flexible control through latent action space.
tldr: OneLA learns continuous latent actions via a shared orthogonal dictionary and a unified predictive objective, enabling world models to be conditioned across diverse domains and improving action readout, cycle-transfer rotation error, and real-scene generation quality.
tldr_zh: OneLA 通过学习共享的正交字典和统一预测目标来获取连续潜在动作，使世界模型能够在不同领域中进行条件控制，并显著改善了动作读出、循环转移旋转误差和真实场景生成质量。
summary_zh: 跨领域学习世界模型需要一个统一的控制空间，然而各领域的动作接口各不相同，且动作标注往往稀缺。直接从视频中学习潜在动作为在没有显式动作监督的情况下建立这样的空间提供了一种有前景的途径。然而，跨领域学习共享的潜在动作仍然具有挑战性，因为外观、具身形态和动态变化可能将领域特定的视觉线索与可迁移的转移结构纠缠在一起。为此，我们提出了OneLA，一个简单框架，通过共享正交字典和共同的预测目标来学习连续潜在动作，在潜在动作预训练阶段无需任务特定设计或跨域对齐损失。这些潜在动作为世界模型提供了共享的条件接口，通过轻量级适配器将本地控制命令映射到同一空间中。以潜在动作和当前视觉状态为条件，世界模型预测上下文相关的转移，以实现可控的展开。OneLA在跨领域动作读取方面有所改进，并将动作周期转移旋转误差相比最强评估基线降低了24.8%。联合训练比较进一步显示，在真实场景生成中，人类偏好评分v3（HPSv3）提升了20.5%。这些结果表明，朝着通用世界模型的方向迈出了一条可行路径，该模型能从多样视频中学习，并通过潜在动作空间支持灵活控制。

title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models
summary: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.
tldr: SonoWorld introduces a causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF probe control using a small EM-tracked dataset, providing a data-driven interactive simulation environment for robotic ultrasound.
tldr_zh: SonoWorld 提出了一种因果、姿态可控的超声世界模型，从无标签临床视频中学习视频动态，并利用少量电磁追踪数据集将其与6自由度探头控制关联，为机器人超声提供数据驱动的交互式仿真环境。
summary_zh: 机器人超声可以标准化图像采集，并降低操作者的工作负担和变异性，但策略学习仍然受到缺乏真实、可控仿真环境的限制。尽管可控世界模型在自然图像领域已取得快速发展，超声世界建模仍具挑战性，因为每一帧仅捕捉未观测三维解剖结构的一个截面，导致探头微小运动即引发较大的外观变化。现有方法依赖机器人跟踪位姿和潜空间预测，但并未直接生成交互控制所需的观测数据。我们提出SonoWorld，一种因果超声世界模型，从无标注的临床视频中学习视频动态，并利用少量由电磁传感器跟踪的徒手临床扫描将其与六自由度控制进行关联。SonoWorld分三个阶段训练：首先在约690万帧无标注的多器官超声图像上预训练一个潜动作条件视频扩散模型；随后利用小型电磁跟踪甲状腺数据集将所学视频动态与公制探头位姿进行关联；最后应用分布匹配蒸馏，实现因果、长时程自回归生成，并在推理时选择性缓存驱逐令牌。我们通过位姿跟踪保真度、往返一致性和合成动作下的轴向特定控制来评估可控性，并使用用户研究进一步验证。在基于模型的动作判别中，SonoWorld在多达74.8%的试验中正确地将目标导向的探头运动排在等幅反向运动之前。据我们所知，SonoWorld是首个主要从徒手临床视频中学习得到的因果、位姿可控超声世界模型，为机器人超声数据采集和策略评估提供了数据驱动的交互环境。

title: Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Models for Consistent Future Frame Prediction
summary: World models of visual information predict future image frames conditioned on given action sequences. This predicted scene evolution is driven by deterministic changes such as controlled motion on a robot platform, as well as stochastic changes such as rendering of manipulated objects or previously occluded regions. Our key insight is that the spatial location of these stochastic changes is itself learnable. We leverage this insight by jointly regressing both the deterministic next-state prediction and the spatial uncertainty map, then using the uncertainty map to guide a conditional diffusion process. We propose Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Model (D3WM), which uses a transformer trained with a Gaussian negative-log-likelihood objective to produce both the deterministic next-state prediction and a spatial map of heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty. The learned uncertainty map then provides a structured spatial gate for a conditional diffusion model: deterministic regions are anchored to the predicted state, while uncertain regions, such as disocclusions or dynamic textures, are sampled by the diffusion process. We frame this decomposition under a variance-gated stochastic differential equation that separates deterministic drift from stochastic diffusion. D3WM shows improved results over competitive baselines in two distinct types of action spaces: robotic tabletop manipulation and camera motion.
tldr: This paper introduces D3WM, a world model that jointly predicts deterministic next frames and a spatial uncertainty map, using the map to gate a conditional diffusion process for consistent future frame prediction in robotics and camera motion scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出D3WM，一种联合预测确定性下一帧和空间不确定性图的世界模型，利用该图门控条件扩散过程，在机器人和相机运动场景中实现一致的未来帧预测。
summary_zh: 世界模型基于给定的动作序列预测未来的图像帧，从而生成场景演化的预测结果。这种预测的场景演化既受到确定性变化（如机器人平台上的受控运动）的驱动，也受到随机变化（如被操作物体或先前被遮挡区域的重渲染）的影响。我们的关键洞察在于，这些随机变化的空间位置本身是可以学习的。基于这一洞察，我们同时回归确定性的下一状态预测和空间不确定性图，并利用不确定性图引导条件扩散过程。为此，我们提出了解耦漂移-扩散世界模型（D3WM），该模型使用以高斯负对数似然为目标训练的Transformer，同时生成确定性的下一状态预测和异方差偶然不确定性的空间图。学习得到的不确定性图随后为条件扩散模型提供结构化的空间门控：确定性区域锚定于预测状态，而不确定区域（如遮挡解除区域或动态纹理）则由扩散过程采样生成。我们将这种分解形式纳入一种方差门控的随机微分方程中，从而将确定性漂移与随机扩散分离。D3WM在两类不同的动作空间中相较于竞争性基线均表现出更优的结果：机器人桌面操作和相机运动。

title: MonoMIP: Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping for Monocular 3D Object Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection methods increasingly rely on depth-guided transformers, but they operate entirely in the perspective image plane where spatial relationships are distorted by foreshortening. We propose MonoMIP, a dual-decoder framework that adds complementary 3D geometric reasoning through Bird's-Eye View (BEV) features constructed via Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping. We perform IPM at K elevation planes spanning ground to rooftop, producing an ordered stack of height-conditioned metric BEV features that reduces above-ground misprojection and exposes depth-dependent appearance variation across planes. A BEV decoder with multi-scale deformable attention aggregates this multi-height evidence per query, while a depth-guided 3D decoder provides complementary perspective-space predictions. Without extra training data, MonoMIP attains 25.84% Moderate AP3D|R40 on KITTI val and 21.66% on the official test set for Car, outperforming recent published monocular methods on both the KITTI and Waymo benchmarks.
tldr: MonoMIP enhances monocular 3D object detection for autonomous driving by constructing multi-height Bird's-Eye-View features via Inverse Perspective Mapping, improving spatial reasoning and detection accuracy on KITTI and Waymo benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MonoMIP通过多高度逆透视映射构建鸟瞰图特征，增强了单目3D目标检测在自动驾驶中的空间推理能力，并在KITTI和Waymo基准上提升了检测精度。
summary_zh: 单目三维目标检测方法日益依赖深度引导的Transformer，但其操作完全局限于透视图像平面，在该平面中空间关系因前缩效应而产生畸变。我们提出MonoMIP，一种双解码器框架，通过多高度逆透视映射构建鸟瞰图（BEV）特征，从而引入互补的三维几何推理能力。我们在从地面到屋顶的K个高度平面上执行IPM，生成一组有序的、基于高度条件的度量BEV特征，该特征可减少地上误投影，并揭示跨平面的深度相关外观变化。配备多尺度可变形注意力的BEV解码器按查询聚合多高度证据，而深度引导的三维解码器则提供互补的透视空间预测。在无额外训练数据的情况下，MonoMIP在KITTI验证集上达到25.84%的Moderate AP3D|R40，在官方测试集上针对Car类别达到21.66%，在KITTI和Waymo基准上均优于近期已发表的单目方法。

title: WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models
summary: As video models enable longer and more realistic interactive experiences, maintaining a world consistent with its history becomes essential. This requires both preserving previously observed content and ensuring coherent world evolution over time. World memory is a critical capability to evaluate alongside visual fidelity and video duration. We introduce WorldMemBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating world memory in video world models. Across 260 test cases, it assesses static memory through the retention of human identity and appearance, object appearance and geometry, and environmental content and geometry, and dynamic memory through event progression and state persistence. Using controlled camera departures and multi-revisit trajectories, the benchmark evaluates static content against fixed initial references and dynamic events against expected state transitions. It combines appearance and geometry metrics with event-specific assessments, and reports video quality and camera-following accuracy as complementary diagnostics. Evaluation of nine representative models shows that strong static retention does not imply reliable dynamic state evolution, while repeated revisits reveal memory degradation beyond the first return. Human studies support the alignment between our automatic evaluations and human judgments. WorldMemBench provides a systematic testbed for diagnosing memory failures and guiding the development of persistent, temporally coherent video worlds.
tldr: WorldMemBench is a benchmark for evaluating world memory in video world models, assessing static and dynamic memory retention across 260 test cases with controlled camera trajectories and multiple models, finding that strong static retention doesn't guarantee dynamic state evolution and memory degrades with repeated revisits.
tldr_zh: WorldMemBench 是一个用于评估视频世界模型中世界记忆的基准，通过260个测试案例和受控相机轨迹评估静态与动态记忆保持，发现强静态保持并不保证动态状态演化，且重复访问会导致记忆退化。
summary_zh: 随着视频模型能够实现更长、更逼真的交互式体验，维持与世界历史的一致性变得至关重要。这不仅要求保留先前观察到的内容，还需确保世界随时间的连贯演化。在评估视觉保真度和视频时长的同时，世界记忆是一项关键能力。我们提出了WorldMemBench，一个用于系统评估视频世界模型中的世界记忆的基准。该基准涵盖260个测试案例，通过人类身份和外观的保持、物体外观和几何结构，以及环境内容和几何结构来评估静态记忆，并通过事件进展和状态持续性来评估动态记忆。利用受控的相机离开及多次重访轨迹，基准将静态内容与固定初始参考进行对照，将动态事件与预期的状态转换进行比较。它结合了外观与几何度量以及事件特定评估，并报告视频质量和相机跟随精度作为补充诊断指标。对九个代表性模型的评估表明，较强的静态记忆保持能力并不必然意味着可靠的动态状态演化，而多次重访则揭示了首次返回之外的记忆衰退现象。人类研究支持我们自动评估与人类判断之间的一致性。WorldMemBench为诊断记忆缺陷以及引导持续、时间连贯的视频世界的发展提供了一个系统性测试平台。

title: One-Step Prediction Fidelity Is a Poor Proxy for Planning Performance in JEPA World Models
summary: Latent world models are routinely selected, checkpointed and ablated on one-step prediction loss, on the assumption that a model which predicts the next latent better is a better model. In model-based RL this assumption is known to be unreliable; we ask whether it also fails for latent world models, where the training target is the model's own embedding and the loss is not expressed in interpretable units. We introduce a frozen-decoder protocol reporting one-step error in physical units, decomposed into the part already present in the encoder's representation and the part the predictor adds. Applying it to a recent end-to-end JEPA world model across three continuous-control environments, we move the metric by fine-tuning and measure goal-conditioned planning on the same checkpoints, with three training seeds and paired planning seeds throughout. Within one environment, a per-epoch ladder shows the relationship saturating after a single epoch: the first epoch improves fidelity by 32% and planning by 4.4 pp, but across the fifteen checkpoints that follow -- a further 15% fidelity improvement, monotone in every training seed -- the correlation between one-step error and planning success is r = -0.010. This is not a task-ceiling artifact: stratifying by a model-independent measure of training-data support, planning in the lowest-support stratum starts at 80%, leaving ample headroom, and is nonetheless flat from epoch 1 onward. Across environments the exchange rate is equally unstable: a 93% fidelity reduction on TwoRoom yields -0.7 pp of planning, while a 40% reduction on PushT yields +4.9 pp [+1.1, +8.9]. All results replicate under a decoder-free measure, latent drift. We also show that a matched continued-training control absorbs the entire fidelity gain we had attributed to an auxiliary objective.
tldr: This paper empirically shows that one-step prediction fidelity is a poor proxy for planning performance in JEPA world models, using a frozen-decoder protocol across continuous-control environments and finding near-zero correlation after the first epoch.
tldr_zh: 本文通过冻结解码器协议，在多个连续控制环境中实证表明，在JEPA世界模型中，一步预测保真度是规划性能的不良代理指标，首个epoch后两者几乎不相关。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通常基于一步预测损失进行选择、检查点保存和消融实验，其假设是能更好预测下一潜在变量的模型即为更优模型。在基于模型的强化学习中，已知该假设并不可靠；我们在此探究这一假设是否同样不适用于潜在世界模型——在这类模型中，训练目标是模型自身的嵌入表示，且损失不以可解释的单位表达。我们引入了一种冻结解码器协议，以物理单位报告一步误差，并将其分解为编码器表示中已存在的部分与预测器新增的部分。将该方法应用于一个最近的端到端JEPA世界模型，覆盖三个连续控制环境，我们通过微调移动该指标，并在相同的检查点上测量目标条件规划性能，全程使用三个训练种子和配对规划种子。在单一环境内，逐轮次阶梯图显示该关系在一个轮次后即趋于饱和：第一个轮次将保真度提升32%，规划性能提升4.4个百分点，但在随后的十五个检查点中——保真度进一步改进15%，且在每个训练种子上均呈单调递增——一步误差与规划成功率之间的相关系数为r = -0.010。这并非任务上限的伪影：通过按模型无关的训练数据支持度进行分层，最低支持层的规划性能起点为80%，留有充足提升空间，且从第1个轮次起始终保持平稳。跨环境而言，兑换率同样不稳定：TwoRoom上93%的保真度降低仅带来-0.7个百分点的规划变化，而PushT上40%的降低却带来+4.9个百分点[+1.1, +8.9]的提升。所有结果在无解码器度量——潜在漂移——下均得到复现。我们还表明，匹配的持续训练对照组吸收了原本归因于辅助目标的全部保真度增益。

title: DD-GBP: Anytime Multi-Arm Planning and Continuous Execution via Distributed Dynamic Gaussian Belief Propagation
summary:
Safely executing long-horizon multi-arm tasks online in complex dynamic environments remains challenging. We propose a new distributed dynamic Gaussian belief propagation (DD-GBP) method that directly plans joint-space trajectories through parallel local inference. A unified Gaussian-process (GP) parameterization connects adaptive planning horizons, interpolation-time factors, and continuous execution. Each robot maintains a local tree-structured factor graph and exchanges messages asynchronously over active inter-arm links. Dynamic subnet reconstruction and event-triggered updates reduce communication and inference costs while responding to moving obstacles. We also provide theoretical analyses of local inference accuracy, anytime early stopping, triggered-replanning consistency, and GP-consistent execution.
  In 50 long-horizon, multi-target four-arm scenes with moving obstacles, DD-GBP achieves $92.5\%$ collision-free all-target completion and the highest success rate among six representative baselines. Scenario ablations demonstrate long-horizon safety and robustness to communication impairment and extreme conditions; success remains $86.0\%$ under $90\%$ packet loss. Execution results further show substantially suppressed extreme velocity and acceleration peaks relative to Syn-GBP. On one workstation, obstacle-free tests with 30 coexisting arms retain $99.87\%$ success and a $15.80$ ms mean warm solve, exceeding 60 Hz and outperforming the compared methods in scalability. Dual-arm transport experiments under dynamic interference demonstrate online response and practical deployability. To the best of our knowledge, these results establish a new state of the art for online long-horizon multi-arm planning in dynamic scenes.
tldr: Presents a distributed dynamic Gaussian belief propagation method for anytime multi-arm planning and continuous execution in long-horizon dynamic tasks, achieving high success and scalability.
tldr_zh: 提出一种分布式动态高斯信念传播方法，用于动态场景中的长时程多臂规划与连续执行，在成功率与可扩展性上表现优异。
summary_zh:
在复杂动态环境中安全地在线执行长时间跨度的多机械臂任务仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种新的分布式动态高斯置信传播（DD-GBP）方法，通过并行局部推理直接规划关节空间轨迹。统一的高斯过程（GP）参数化将自适应规划时域、插值时间因子与连续执行相连接。每个机械臂维护一个局部树结构因子图，并通过主动臂间链路异步交换消息。动态子网重构与事件触发更新在响应移动障碍物的同时，降低了通信与推理成本。我们还提供了局部推理精度、任意时刻早停、触发重规划一致性以及GP一致执行的理论分析。

在包含移动障碍物的50个长时间跨度、多目标四臂场景中，DD-GBP实现了92.5%的无碰撞全目标完成率，并在六个代表性基线方法中取得了最高成功率。场景消融实验证明了长时间跨度的安全性以及对通信损伤和极端条件的鲁棒性；在90%丢包率下成功率仍保持86.0%。执行结果进一步表明，相对于Syn-GBP，速度和加速度的极端峰值得到显著抑制。在单台工作站上，30个共存机械臂的无障碍测试保持了99.87%的成功率，平均热启动求解时间为15.80毫秒，超过60 Hz，在可扩展性上优于对比方法。在动态干扰下的双机械臂搬运实验展示了在线响应能力和实际可部署性。据我们所知，这些结果确立了动态场景中在线长时间跨度多机械臂规划的最新最优水平。

title: Why 3D Reconstruction Breaks Down on Under-Ice AUV Video, and How to Predict It
summary: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.
tldr: This paper analyzes why four different 3D reconstruction methods fail on under-ice AUV video, attributing failures to a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio, and proposes a system to predict this failure within minutes.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了四种不同三维重建方法在冰下AUV视频上失败的原因，将其归因于相机基线-场景深度比过小，并提出了一种在数分钟内预测此类失败的系统。
summary_zh: 利用水下AUV视频资料进行三维结构重建一直存在精度不足的问题，尽管尚不确定这是由于方法本身的缺陷还是采集系统的固有不足所致。我们在同一组南极冰下AUV视频数据（Icefin，Kamb冰流）上测试了四种不同的重建模型：经典特征匹配的SFM（运动恢复结构）方法、可微光度散射方法、体素深度融合方法以及无需位姿的前馈基础模型。四种方法均未能成功重建，且各自以不同的方式失效：近全局配准几乎未能产生任何结构；尽管光度指标正常，但输出的几何结构已损坏；存在持续性的覆盖伪影；跨块尺度不稳定。我们证明，这四种失败模式均与同一采集条件相符，即相机基线相对于场景深度的比值过小。基于上述分析，我们提出了一种检测系统，能在数分钟内识别此类失败，而非浪费数小时的计算资源。

title: Mixed-Reality Feedback Control: Towards Blending of Control and Digital Twinning
summary: Technologies, such as co-simulation, in particular, digital twins (DTs) are used for comprehensive and reliable prototyping, verification and validation (V&V) of control systems. There, the combination of feedback loops across multiple realities (e.g., simulations, physical setups) enables various forms of experimentation with robots and autonomous systems. However, the handling of multiple realities requires a more specific support by the modelling techniques used in control engineering. To streamline the latter in the system life cycle, we propose a framework for mixing (i.e., fusing, defusing) control input and feedback signals (i.e., stimuli, responses) in simultaneously operated plants for multiple realities.
tldr: The paper proposes a framework for mixing control inputs and feedback signals across multiple realities (e.g., simulations and physical setups) to support digital twinning and mixed-reality feedback control for robots and autonomous systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于在多个现实（如仿真和物理装置）之间混合控制输入和反馈信号，以支持机器人和自主系统的数字孪生及混合现实反馈控制。
summary_zh: 诸如联合仿真等技术，特别是数字孪生（DTs），被用于控制系统全面且可靠的样机开发、验证与确认（V&V）。在此过程中，跨多重现实（例如，仿真、物理装置）的反馈回路组合，使得对机器人和自主系统的多种形式实验成为可能。然而，处理多重现实要求控制工程中所使用的建模技术提供更具体的支持。为了在系统生命周期中简化这一过程，我们提出了一种框架，用于在同时运行的多重现实设备中混合（即，融合、解除融合）控制输入和反馈信号（即，激励、响应）。

title: What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization
summary: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach from 16.0% to 95.3%. Where it reaches the policy but not the decision, only new downstream wiring recovers goal reach, from 31.6% to 84.3% in the environment with the action shortcut. Where it is inert, neither works. Our results show that goal misgeneralization is not a single failure of goal representation, but distinct failures of policy alignment at different depths, tightly connected to which recovery works.
tldr: This paper analyzes goal misgeneralization in reinforcement learning agents across Procgen environments and robot tasks, identifying three distinct policy-goal misalignment failure modes and their implications for recovery strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了强化学习智能体在Procgen环境和机器人任务中的目标误泛化现象，识别出三种不同的策略-目标错位失败模式及其对恢复策略的影响。
summary_zh: 目标误泛化是一种常见的失效模式，即智能体在分布外场景中表现出能干的行为，却并未追求预期目标。然而，对于误泛化智能体中预期目标究竟发生了什么，我们目前的理解仍较为有限。在三个Procgen环境与五个机器人任务中，我们发现了三种不同形式的策略-目标错位：（1）功能性目标替代，即行为遵循替代目标；（2）策略捷径，即行为遵循习得的动作策略；（3）预期目标线索与代理目标线索之间的线索竞争。我们通过追踪目标信息在内部何处仍然可用、其对策略的影响强度以及其在动作选择中所扮演的角色来区分这三种模式，并发现目标在不同深度上发生丢失。当目标能够到达决策层时（如线索竞争情形），转向干预能够将策略重新引导至目标位置，使预期目标达成率从16.0%提升至95.3%。当目标到达策略层但未到达决策层时，只有新增下游连接才能恢复目标达成率，在存在动作捷径的环境中，该比率从31.6%提升至84.3%。当目标处于惰性状态时，两种方法均无效。我们的结果表明，目标误泛化并非目标表征的单一失效，而是不同深度上策略对齐的多种不同失效，且与哪种恢复方法有效密切相关。

title: Dungeon and Visibility World Generator
summary: Robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms require reproducible environments with controllable geometry and visibility. This paper presents the Dungeon and Visibility World Generator, an open-source framework for constructing two- and three-dimensional environments and evaluating geometric line-of-sight. The framework supports orthogonal, polygonal or polyhedral, and curvilinear geometries, with six construction families covering scattered rooms, clusters, winding passages, caverns, branches, and loops. Room dimensions, passage structures, obstacles, and spatial placement can be controlled through configurable parameters and probability distributions. Each generated environment provides continuous free-space geometry and a corresponding discrete occupancy representation. A Rust-based visibility engine supports line-of-sight queries in both representations, enabling the evaluation of observable regions from arbitrary agent positions. The framework records configurations, generated geometries, occupancy grids, and visibility results to support reproducible experiments. We demonstrate the generator across all six geometry classes, examine how geometry and spatial resolution affect visibility, and evaluate generation time and reproducibility. The resulting framework provides a configurable foundation for evaluating robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms in diverse environments.
tldr: This paper introduces the Dungeon and Visibility World Generator, an open-source framework for creating reproducible 2D and 3D environments with controllable geometry and a Rust-based visibility engine, aimed at evaluating robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Dungeon and Visibility World Generator，这是一个开源框架，用于创建具有可控几何形状和基于Rust的可见性引擎的可复现2D和3D环境，旨在评估机器人探索、覆盖和多智能体部署算法。
summary_zh: 机器人探索、覆盖以及多智能体部署算法需要具备可控几何形状与可视性的可复现环境。本文介绍了地牢与可视性世界生成器，这是一个开源框架，用于构建二维和三维环境并评估几何视线。该框架支持正交、多边形或多面体以及曲线几何，并提供了六种构建族系，涵盖散落房间、簇群、蜿蜒通道、洞穴、分支和环路。房间尺寸、通道结构、障碍物及空间布局可通过可配置参数和概率分布进行控制。每个生成环境都提供连续自由空间几何及对应的离散占据表示。基于Rust的可视性引擎支持在两种表示中进行视线查询，从而能够评估任意智能体位置的可观测区域。该框架记录配置、生成几何、占据栅格及可视性结果，以支持可复现实验。我们展示了生成器在全部六类几何中的表现，考察了几何与空间分辨率对可视性的影响，并评估了生成时间与可复现性。该框架为在多样化环境中评估机器人探索、覆盖及多智能体部署算法提供了可配置的基础。

title: A Master-to-Simulation Interface with Demonstration-Trajectory Guidance for Vascular Intervention
summary: Robotic vascular intervention can reduce radiation exposure to physicians and improve manipulation stability, but effective guidance remains challenging because conventional fluoroscopic images provide limited spatial information. This paper developed a vascular intervention interactive system that connects a real robotic master controller with the SOFA(Simulation Open Framework Architecture) physical simulation platform and reused successful operation trajectories as visual guidance in physical phantom experiments. Experiments were conducted to validate the master-to-SOFA control loop and to compare three guidance conditions: no guidance, centerline guidance, and successful-trajectory guidance. The control validation results showed reliable command delivery under velocity-mode operation. In the physical phantom experiment, centerline guidance showed no obvious improvement over no guidance. In contrast, successful trajectory guidance provided a clear performance benefit. Compared with the no-guidance condition, it reduced task completion time, collision number, rollback number, and rotation number by approximately 66.8%, 34.3%, 55.6%, and 66.7%, respectively. These results indicate that successful trajectories obtained under instrument-vessel interaction can provide practical guidance cues, offering a simple and effective visual assistance strategy for robotic vascular intervention experiments.
tldr: This paper presents a master-to-simulation (SOFA) interface for robotic vascular intervention, and demonstrates that reusing successful demonstration trajectories as visual guidance significantly improves task performance in physical phantom experiments compared to no guidance or centerline guidance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人血管介入的主端到仿真（SOFA）接口，并通过物理模型实验证明，与无引导或中心线引导相比，重用成功演示轨迹作为视觉引导可显著提高任务性能。
summary_zh: 机器人血管介入可减少医生受辐射剂量并提升操作稳定性，但由于传统透视图像提供的空间信息有限，有效引导仍具挑战。本文构建了一个将真实机器人主控端与SOFA（模拟开放框架架构）物理仿真平台相连接的血管介入交互系统，并在实体体模实验中复用成功操作轨迹作为视觉引导。实验验证了主控端至SOFA的控制回路，并比较了三种引导条件：无引导、中心线引导和成功轨迹引导。控制验证结果表明，在速度模式下指令传递可靠。在实体体模实验中，中心线引导相较于无引导无明显改善；而成功轨迹引导则展现出显著性能优势。与无引导条件相比，任务完成时间、碰撞次数、回退次数和旋转次数分别减少了约66.8%、34.3%、55.6%和66.7%。上述结果表明，在器械-血管相互作用下获取的成功轨迹能够提供实用的引导线索，为机器人血管介入实验提供了一种简单有效的视觉辅助策略。

title: Probabilistic Physics Digital Twin for Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Digital twins are increasingly used in robotics to simulate interactions, predict action outcomes, and support planning. However, constructing accurate digital twins requires precise estimates of physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of mass, which are often difficult to obtain in real-world environments. We propose probabilistic digital twins, which represent uncertain physical properties as probability distributions rather than fixed values. By simulating actions across these distributions, the twin predicts a range of possible outcomes and their likelihoods. These probabilistic simulations can guide both human and robot actions by identifying actions that are effective despite physical uncertainty. We demonstrate this framework through human-robot interaction scenarios, including interfaces that communicate simulated outcomes to users and robot planning strategies that explicitly account for uncertainty.
tldr: This paper proposes probabilistic digital twins that represent uncertain physical properties as probability distributions, enabling robust simulation and planning for human-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出概率数字孪生方法，将不确定的物理属性表示为概率分布，以支持人机交互中的鲁棒模拟和规划。
summary_zh: 数字孪生在机器人技术中的应用日益广泛，用于模拟交互、预测行动结果以及辅助规划。然而，构建精确的数字孪生需要对质量、摩擦力和质心等物理属性进行精确估算，而这些属性在现实环境中往往难以获取。为此，我们提出概率数字孪生的概念，将不确定的物理属性表示为概率分布，而非固定值。通过对这些分布上的动作进行模拟，该孪生模型能够预测一系列可能的结果及其发生的可能性。这些概率性模拟通过识别在物理不确定性下依然有效的动作，能够同时指导人类和机器人的行动。我们通过人机交互场景展示了这一框架，包括向用户传达模拟结果的交互界面，以及明确考虑不确定性的机器人规划策略。

title: MIND: Instruction-Conditioned Incremental Grounding for Robots
summary: Robots following persistent language instructions must decide which cached room judgments remain valid as their environment changes. We present MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies), a framework for maintaining target-room decisions without re-evaluating every room after each event. A language model compiles each instruction into dependencies for semantic qualification and target selection. The controller intersects semantic dependencies with event footprints, refreshes affected judgments, and updates reachability and selection separately. For fixed deterministic evaluation, planning, and selection, conservative dependency and footprint coverage preserves the decisions of full recomputation. On 240 five-event ProcTHOR sequences with an exact benchmark predicate, MIND reduces mean semantic evaluations from 30.6 to 11.2 while preserving all 1,200 post-event decisions. Frozen-evaluator experiments with Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B also preserve all 1,200 decisions, without improving the evaluators' underlying task accuracy. In 32 closed-loop AI2-THOR episodes using exact-predicate qualification and metadata-derived footprints, MIND matches the final target decision of full recomputation in every episode. Unitree G1 experiments demonstrate target reuse and reselection across room transitions without additional semantic evaluations under MIND, and abstention after a barrier and an object removal at 4 evaluations against 15 to 18. Additional materials are available at https://mind-icra27.github.io/.
tldr: MIND is a framework that incrementally maintains target-room decisions for persistent language instructions in embodied agents by using a language model to compile dependencies and event footprints, reducing semantic evaluations while preserving decision accuracy.
tldr_zh: MIND 是一个框架，通过使用语言模型编译依赖关系和事件足迹，增量维护具身代理在持续语言指令下的目标房间决策，在保持决策准确性的同时减少语义评估次数。
summary_zh: 遵循持久语言指令的机器人必须在其环境变化时，判断哪些已缓存的房间判断仍然有效。我们提出MIND（基于指令条件依赖的维护）框架，该框架无需在每次事件后重新评估每个房间，即可维护目标房间决策。语言模型将每条指令编译为语义限定和目标选择所对应的依赖关系。控制器将语义依赖与事件足迹相交，刷新受影响的判断，并分别更新可达性和目标选择。对于固定的确定性评估、规划与选择，保守的依赖及足迹覆盖范围能够保持完整重计算的决策结果。在240条包含五个事件的ProcTHOR序列实验中，采用精确基准谓词时，MIND将平均语义评估次数从30.6次降至11.2次，同时保留了全部1200个事件后决策。使用Phi-4和Qwen3-14B的冻结评估器实验同样保留了全部1200个决策，且未提升评估器在底层任务上的准确率。在32个闭环AI2-THOR回合中，采用精确谓词限定和基于元数据的足迹信息，MIND在每个回合中均与完整重计算的最终目标决策保持一致。Unitree G1实验表明，在MIND框架下，房间切换时可复用或重新选择目标而无需额外的语义评估；在设置障碍物和移除物体后，模型选择弃权，此时仅需4次评估，而完整重计算需要15至18次。更多材料请见 https://mind-icra27.github.io/。

title: Benchmarking 3D Reconstruction for Under-Ice Robotic Perception in Arctic Environments
summary:
As the Arctic transitions toward a seasonally ice-free state, capturing the complex morphology of submerged sea ice is crucial for advancing models of ocean-ice-atmosphere heat exchange and monitoring under-ice habitats.
  Currently, sub-surface ice mapping is predominantly achieved through acoustic sensors such as multibeam sonar. While sonar provides robust large-scale geometry, it lacks spectral and high-resolution textural information required to record fine morphological features - a critical limitation in under-ice environments, where sparse visual features and degraded sensing conditions challenge the capture of detailed structural and optical surface properties.
  We present a benchmark for vision-based under-ice 3D reconstruction using real-world data from the MOSAiC expedition and synthetic data generated in an Unreal Engine-based underwater robotics simulator. The benchmark evaluates Structure-From-Motion (SfM) and monocular depth estimation, with quantitative comparison enabled through cross-modal registration to upward-looking multibeam sonar.
tldr: This paper presents a benchmark for vision-based 3D reconstruction in under-ice Arctic environments, using real MOSAiC data and synthetic simulator data, and evaluates SfM and monocular depth estimation against sonar ground truth.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个针对北极冰下环境的视觉三维重建基准，利用MOSAiC真实数据和模拟器合成数据，评估运动恢复结构和单目深度估计方法。
summary_zh:
随着北极向季节性无冰状态过渡，捕捉水下海冰的复杂形态对于推进海洋-冰-大气热交换模型及监测冰下栖息地至关重要。目前，水下冰面测绘主要依靠多波束声纳等声学传感器实现。尽管声纳能够提供稳健的大尺度几何信息，但其缺乏记录精细形态特征所需的光谱及高分辨率纹理信息——这在冰下环境中尤为受限，因为该环境中稀疏的视觉特征和退化的感知条件对捕捉详细的结构与光学表面属性构成了挑战。

我们提出了一种基于视觉的冰下三维重建基准，利用来自MOSAiC考察的真实数据及基于虚幻引擎的水下机器人模拟器生成的合成数据。该基准评估了运动恢复结构（SfM）与单目深度估计方法，并通过与向上观测多波束声纳的跨模态配准实现定量比较。

title: RingNav: Task-Shaped Circular Memory for Visual Heading
summary: Tiny robots have limited computation and memory, yet visual navigation systems often maintain more state than a task requires. We ask whether persistent memory can instead be shaped by the task. We present \textbf{RingNav}, a \(10.6\)k--parameter visual heading estimator that constrains its memory to the circular manifold \(S^1\). RingNav learns only the turn between consecutive images, while heading is composed directly on the circle. On the TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge, RingNav reduces mean absolute turn error by \(27\%\) and accumulated heading error over $4$ sec by \(15\%\) relative to a similarly sized learned-memory model. The structured update also gives exactly zero turn for identical frames and exact cancellation under sequence reversal. Without fine-tuning, RingNav transfers to real-world drone experiments and continues estimating heading under severe visual degradation. RingNav runs at $27.3$Hz on Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and can be deployed on an ultra-low power GAP8 processor at $33.4$Hz.
tldr: RingNav proposes a task-shaped circular memory for visual heading estimation on tiny robots, constraining memory to the S^1 manifold and learning only turns between images, achieving improved accuracy and efficiency on TartanAir and real drone experiments.
tldr_zh: RingNav 提出了一种任务形状的循环记忆，用于微型机器人上的视觉航向估计，将记忆限制在 S^1 流形上并仅学习图像之间的转向，在 TartanAir 和真实无人机实验中提高了精度和效率。
summary_zh: 微型机器人的计算与存储资源有限，然而视觉导航系统所维护的状态往往超出任务实际所需。我们探讨是否能够依据任务需求来塑造持久记忆。为此，我们提出了**RingNav**，一个仅含\(10.6\)k参数的视觉航向估计器，其记忆被限制在圆形流形\(S^1\)上。RingNav仅学习连续图像之间的转角，而航向则直接在圆上进行合成。在TartanAir视觉SLAM挑战赛中，与规模相当的带学习记忆模型相比，RingNav的平均绝对转角误差降低了\(27\%\)，且在\(4\)秒内的累计航向误差减少了\(15\%\)。结构化更新还使得相同帧间的转角精确为零，并在序列反转时实现精确抵消。无需微调，RingNav即可迁移至真实世界的无人机实验中，并在严重的视觉退化条件下持续估计航向。RingNav在Raspberry Pi Zero 2W上以\(27.3\)Hz的频率运行，并可部署于超低功耗的GAP8处理器上，运行频率达\(33.4\)Hz。

title: Imagining Goals with Geometric Horizon Models for Policy Generalization
summary: Training from offline data has allowed for substantial progress in domains such as robotics, leading to general-purpose policies that can be easily applied zero-shot or efficiently finetuned for downstream tasks. However, these policies can still have poor generalization, both due to the choice of modeling objective and from learning from a static dataset. In this work, we focus on the challenging task of zero-shot goal generalization, where a policy is evaluated on unseen tasks that require combining its existing knowledge (compositional generalization). An avenue for improving a policy's generalization is by generating new experience with world models; however, such generation has proven difficult for longer horizons. Thus, to alleviate this issue, we propose TD-Aug, which samples from a geometric horizon model and allows for directly imagining novel outcomes that can be achieved by composing existing knowledge. We demonstrate that training on these future outcomes as goals for goal-conditioned BC policies significantly improves generalization in stitching-based OGBench tasks.
tldr: TD-Aug samples from a geometric horizon model to imagine novel goals for goal-conditioned BC policies, improving zero-shot compositional generalization in OGBench tasks.
tldr_zh: TD-Aug 从几何视界模型中采样以想象新目标，用于目标条件行为克隆策略，提升 OGBench 任务中的零样本组合泛化能力。
summary_zh: 从离线数据训练已在机器人等领域取得了显著进展，催生了通用策略，这些策略能够轻松地以零样本方式应用，或通过微调高效适配下游任务。然而，由于建模目标的选择以及从静态数据集学习的局限性，这些策略的泛化能力仍可能不足。本研究聚焦于零样本目标泛化这一具有挑战性的任务，即策略需在未见任务上通过组合已有知识完成评估（组合泛化）。提升策略泛化能力的一个途径是利用世界模型生成新经验；然而，对于较长视界，这种生成已被证明较为困难。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种名为TD-Aug的方法，该方法从几何视界模型中采样，从而能够直接想象通过组合现有知识可实现的新颖结果。我们证明，在这些未来结果作为目标训练条件为目标的BC策略，显著提升了基于拼接的OGBench任务中的泛化性能。

title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.
tldr: This survey systematically reviews data-centric methods for fine-tuning multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to improve spatial reasoning, categorizing dataset design, construction, and evaluation, and identifying future research directions.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述系统地回顾了以数据为中心的方法，通过微调多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）来提升空间推理能力，对数据集设计、构建和评估进行分类，并指出了未来的研究方向。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已广泛应用于具身智能体和机器人领域的视觉任务中。然而，MLLMs在空间推理和感知方面存在局限性。后训练技术已显示出提升这些能力的潜力；然而，目前对此类方法的数据驱动综述较为有限。本综述考察了针对空间推理任务对预训练MLLMs进行微调的方法，涵盖从监督学习到强化学习的各类技术，并重点关注所用数据集。我们探讨了数据集构建、数据模态与标注以及所得模型评估等主题。基于这些主题，我们将研究分为三类：数据集设计、数据集构建和评估。我们发现构建固定空间标注主要有四种方法：规则与模板、大语言模型提示、程序化生成以及人在回路。同时，我们观察到评估方法存在显著差异，包括不同的评分方式、容差指标和基准类型。最后，我们指出了未来研究的机会，包括统一动态标注、高效空间推理、评估标准化、空间范围扩展以及以人为中心的空间交互。

title: SPECTRA-VLA: Base-Fine Hyperspectral Token Transfer at Frozen Vision-Language-Action Interfaces
summary: Hyperspectral imaging distinguishes RGB-similar objects, but a pretrained vision-language-action model needs a state its frozen decoder can use. SPECTRA-VLA provides a native-width spectral upgrade without retraining the visual encoder or action decoder. A learned continuous residual enriches each target token through its own normalized false-color reference; projection, norm control and validation-calibrated injection regulate the change. Across 86 held-out acquisitions, category balanced accuracy rises from 0.812 to 0.883. With identical residuals and scale, own-token addition improves reuse of an external category-derived probe on frozen decoder logits: 0.701 versus 0.590 with pooled replacement, at similar image-disjoint recognition. Five grouped tests covering the same 86 acquisitions recover within-category spectral shape with $R^2=0.802/0.337$ from continuous and posterior-code states. Category-matched spectral swaps further show that own-token composition approximately doubles the target-specific recovery increment after frozen decoding. Spectral enrichment and receiving-token preservation thus work together at the pretrained interface.
tldr: SPECTRA-VLA introduces a method to adapt vision-language-action (VLA) models to hyperspectral input by injecting learned continuous residuals into frozen VLA tokens, improving classification and spectral recovery without retraining the VLA model.
tldr_zh: SPECTRA-VLA 提出一种方法，通过在冻结的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的token中注入学习到的连续残差，使其适应高光谱输入，在不重训练VLA模型的情况下提高分类和光谱恢复性能。
